l6Zp492Ag2.method: The paper studies closing sets that jointly reconstruct targets and characterizes information and exchange barriers. It analyzes paired designs with opposite nuisance components and cyclic nuisance correlations, with exact recovery of globally optimal batches in paired designs.
l6Zp492Ag2.key_idea: Analyze complete measurement groups whose jointly canceling nuisance components reveal target information unavailable to smaller subsets.
l6Zp492Ag2.evidence: A four-measurement example and theoretical analyses show zero submodularity ratio, indistinguishability from small subsets, and strict local optima even under exact risk evaluation.
l6Zp492Ag2.claimed_gains: In the four-measurement example, replacing all four measurements lowers risk to 9.6% of its starting value, while replacing one, two or three raises it.

Y3jSBUnOe5.one_liner: Separable partial-image conditions combine with optional spatial layouts and text to control native 3D generation.
Y3jSBUnOe5.problem: Indirect 2D-to-3D control pipelines accumulate errors and lack an efficient feed-forward mechanism amid limited high-quality 3D training data.
Y3jSBUnOe5.method: Partial3D treats partial images as independent visual conditions for compositional 3D synthesis and editing by image replacement. A Spatial Prompt Modulator supplies optional 3D layout guidance, while training-free velocity fusion incorporates text guidance.
Y3jSBUnOe5.key_idea: Condition native 3D generation on separable image parts, adding layout modulation and text-guided velocity fusion.

ADdF4aLjzu.one_liner: A single-pass end-of-sequence detector prunes redundant 1D video tokens before diffusion decoding, enabling search-free dynamic-length video tokenization.
ADdF4aLjzu.problem: Fixed-length 2D/3D video tokenizers hinder semantic representation and autoregressive modeling, whereas existing 1D dynamic-length tokenizers require costly inference-time search for token counts.
ADdF4aLjzu.method: D^3-Tok maps video content to a set of 1D latent tokens, discards redundant tokens in a single forward pass via an end-of-sequence detector, and reconstructs the video from the remaining tokens using a diffusion decoder.
ADdF4aLjzu.key_idea: Prune redundant 1D video latent tokens in one forward pass with an end-of-sequence detector and reconstruct the video via a diffusion decoder.
ADdF4aLjzu.evidence: Evaluated on video reconstruction (rFVD and gFVD) and downstream autoregressive video generation against fixed-length 2D/3D and 1D video tokenizers.

dObNvUcGgD.one_liner: Combining process-conditioned SEM triplets with metrology and defect metrics evaluates lithography predictions beyond image similarity.
dObNvUcGgD.problem: Existing lithography benchmarks and image metrics fail to jointly assess geometric evolution and defect formation under continuous process variation.
dObNvUcGgD.method: FabBench provides physics-grounded, real-SEM-informed triplets with structured in-distribution and out-of-distribution splits. Its hierarchical evaluation measures visual fidelity, localized dimensional accuracy, and topological defect consistency.
dObNvUcGgD.key_idea: Evaluate process-conditioned lithography using paired geometric and defect criteria at image, localized metrology, and topology levels.
dObNvUcGgD.evidence: Evaluations on 547K triplets find that high image similarity can coexist with substantial fabrication-aligned dimensional and defect errors.

61DDs6D9P6.one_liner: Teacher-endpoint distillation and blockwise KV-cache pipelining enable one-step asynchronous world-action inference.
61DDs6D9P6.problem: Multi-step action denoising and sequential video–action expert execution limit world action model inference efficiency.
61DDs6D9P6.method: RealtimeWAM adds frozen teacher rollout-endpoint supervision to local consistency distillation for one-step action prediction. Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining overlaps video and action experts through blockwise video KV sharing, synchronizing immediately before the action attention consumes each block.
61DDs6D9P6.key_idea: Distill actions against both local consistency and teacher endpoints, then overlap experts by sharing video KV blocks just before action attention needs them.
61DDs6D9P6.evidence: The abstract lists experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin and model variants including Fast-WAM, but truncates before results.

D12cdNLNBB.one_liner: Persistent diagram object graphs and scope-validated atomic edits preserve existing content during scientific figure revisions.
D12cdNLNBB.problem: Systems without persistent figure state regenerate content for small edits and disturb previously verified parts of a diagram.
D12cdNLNBB.method: IteraFigure stores diagrams as persistent object graphs and applies revisions as atomic edit batches. A deterministic guard validates batches against optional user-selected scopes, and dependent deletions outside the selection require previewed authorization.
D12cdNLNBB.key_idea: Represent diagrams as persistent object graphs and validate complete operation batches against selected scopes before committing edits atomically.
D12cdNLNBB.evidence: FigureBench assesses overall quality, a matched-input protocol tests single-turn local editing, and ten-step mixed editing chains evaluate repeated revisions.
D12cdNLNBB.claimed_gains: IteraFigure strictly passes 99.3% of single-turn local edits under a matched-input protocol while preserving every unrelated visible-text item.

wSa1pInOBu.one_liner: Matched correction interventions separate gradient rankings, guided repair quality, and unguided policy performance in frozen occupancy models.
wSa1pInOBu.problem: Small final recovery gains do not reveal whether camera-based occupancy repair fails because of the correction or how it is applied.
wSa1pInOBu.method: The study uses matched interventions to compare gradient-favored rankings with post-correction outcomes and guided corrections with unguided application. It varies allocation policy, correction strength, and occupancy objective, including training on post-correction loss.
wSa1pInOBu.key_idea: Separate correction quality from application policy using matched interventions and optimize policies against post-correction loss rather than initial-gradient rankings.
wSa1pInOBu.evidence: Matched PanoOcc experiments show ranking reversals after correction and reduced gains when ground-truth-guided corrections must be applied without prior guidance.
wSa1pInOBu.claimed_gains: Training on post-correction loss improves mIoU by 1.80 pp over gradient-based supervision and recovers 16.74% of the Clean–Degraded performance gap.

feMFdRSPF4.one_liner: Comparing projector demands with encoder capacity triggers direct encoder constraints when representation differences cannot be sustained.
feMFdRSPF4.problem: Batch-normalized projectors remove shared encoder components, leaving output regularization unable to prevent collapse of encoder representation differences.
feMFdRSPF4.method: SADL retains the original training objective and compares representation differences demanded by the projector output with those the encoder can preserve and transmit. It adds an encoder constraint only when supply falls below demand, without extra trainable parameters or architectural changes.
feMFdRSPF4.key_idea: Constrain the encoder only when its capacity to retain and transmit representation differences falls below the projector output's demand.
feMFdRSPF4.evidence: Single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel and INTACT experiments use ten random seeds and examine effective rank, prediction error, and sensitivity to loss weight.
feMFdRSPF4.claimed_gains: SADL lowers collapse from 50% to 0%; after one epoch, encoder effective rank is 3.4–6.4× the baseline and latent prediction error falls to 1/20–1/303 of it.

PFdRMNxdY1.one_liner: Geometrically verified tracking and SLAM-aligned supervision train joint world-grounded reconstruction from egocentric video.
PFdRMNxdY1.problem: Egocentric reconstruction lacks jointly aligned supervision and models that keep observer motion, scene geometry, and hand–object interactions coherent.
PFdRMNxdY1.method: EgoX-Engine couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment to annotate camera, scene, hands, and objects consistently. EgoX uses these data and complementary public annotations for joint metric reconstruction from monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks.
PFdRMNxdY1.key_idea: Align tracked objects and camera, scene, and hand supervision in a common SLAM-based world frame to train joint egocentric reconstruction.
PFdRMNxdY1.evidence: EgoX-Data-6M contains 50 hours of indoor and outdoor manipulation and locomotion with second-level captions, with one hour selected for EgoX-Bench joint-reconstruction evaluation.

YdsjapGMYI.one_liner: Cross-session human feedback updates agent context, weights, and evolving rubrics to learn individual task criteria.
YdsjapGMYI.problem: Population-trained agents struggle to meet personal professional standards that users reveal through interaction rather than fully specifying beforehand.
YdsjapGMYI.method: TAHI integrates cross-session human–agent interaction signals into agent context and model weights. An evolving rubric module captures each user's training and evaluation criteria as they emerge.
YdsjapGMYI.key_idea: Accumulate interaction-derived personal criteria in evolving rubrics and use them to adapt both agent context and weights across sessions.
YdsjapGMYI.evidence: Experiments adapt agents to 30 individuals across 600 writing and visual-creation tasks and compare failure detection by generated rubrics with LM-only or human-only rubrics.
YdsjapGMYI.claimed_gains: Agents improve solo task success by 4.5–20.9% within tens of tasks, and evolving rubrics catch 16.0–22.3% more failures than rubrics from LMs or humans alone.

fmn7RIbLmF.one_liner: Simulating document-generated adapters during alignment trains safety LoRAs or hypernetworks that resist parametric in-context safety erosion.
fmn7RIbLmF.problem: Internalizing benign documents through parametric in-context learning weakens safety in ways existing alignment methods fail to address across diverse generated adapters.
fmn7RIbLmF.method: PICLAlign simulates PICL during alignment, either training a safety LoRA to compose with generated adapters or tuning the hypernetwork to generate safer adapters. Doc-DRO optimizes worst-case loss over a neighborhood of document distributions to address atypical unseen-document erosion.
fmn7RIbLmF.key_idea: Align against simulated document-generated LoRAs, intervening through a composable safety adapter or its generating hypernetwork and optimizing document-distribution worst cases.
fmn7RIbLmF.evidence: Analysis across three PICL-integrated LLM systems finds safety erosion from benign-document internalization, whereas ordinary in-context presentation of the same documents causes little or no degradation.

RtSyrb0eHW.one_liner: Independent writer–reader adapters trained against a frozen anchor make persistent latent memories readable across heterogeneous language models.
RtSyrb0eHW.problem: Pairwise latent projections require quadratic training, while existing shared spaces constrain new-member admission and have only demonstrated one-family interoperability.
RtSyrb0eHW.method: MEMHUB trains one writer–reader adapter pair per frozen model against a small frozen anchor defining a shared latent coordinate system. Models independently write persistent artifacts that other members can read without pairwise training or incumbent retraining.
RtSyrb0eHW.key_idea: Train each model's writer and reader independently against one frozen anchor so persistent latent artifacts share a portable coordinate system.
RtSyrb0eHW.evidence: Evaluation covers nine models from five families spanning 0.5B–8B parameters, 72 foreign directions, held-out-family onboarding, dataset shift, and 432 cross-hub directions.
RtSyrb0eHW.claimed_gains: MEMHUB recovers median 96.1% of pair-specific readout gains, retains 97% of self-transfer under dataset shift, and reads a 64 KB artifact with 21–33× faster time to first token than a live text handoff.

QUvCatjZ1x.one_liner: FANO anchors the previous denoised estimate and optimizes forward-noise direction and radius under a soft radial constraint.
QUvCatjZ1x.problem: Direct denoiser-input optimization causes radial noise drift that worsens at low noise levels and degrades inverse reconstruction.
QUvCatjZ1x.method: At each annealing layer, FANO fixes the preceding denoiser estimate and optimizes forward noise instead of the denoiser input. It expresses noise in polar coordinates and regulates its magnitude with a soft potential.
QUvCatjZ1x.key_idea: Optimize forward noise around a fixed denoised anchor and softly constrain its radius to preserve typical diffusion-input geometry.
QUvCatjZ1x.evidence: The analysis bounds direct-input within-layer deviation by a quantity growing as 1/σ_t and shows that forward-noise optimization removes this dependence.

ubqecIxYBR.one_liner: SARM2 combines shared action-primitive stages with a multi-gate mixture-of-experts value head to supply dense rewards for robotic self-improvement.
ubqecIxYBR.problem: Task-specific reward models require repeated annotation and training, while general reward models miss subtle progress in long-horizon manipulation.
ubqecIxYBR.method: SARM2 combines a shared action-primitive stage estimator with a multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts value head. SPIRAL uses its dense rewards in an offline-to-online pipeline learning from demonstrations and autonomous rollouts.
ubqecIxYBR.key_idea: Combine a shared action-primitive stage estimator with a multi-gate expert value head for multitask dense reward prediction.
ubqecIxYBR.evidence: Experiments on ten tasks evaluate value-estimation MSE and offline-to-online success on shorts folding and whiteboard cleaning.
ubqecIxYBR.claimed_gains: SARM2 reduces MSE by 33.3% versus multitask SARM and 53.5% versus the best evaluated general-purpose baseline, while SPIRAL raises success from 60% to 100%, 33.3% to 66.7%, and 50% to 90.0% on Folding Flattened Shorts, Folding Crumpled Shorts, and Cleaning Whiteboard, respectively.

qZcpegZiC8.one_liner: DRBench Pro generates relation-level rubrics from knowledge trees to measure research reports' coverage breadth and depth.
qZcpegZiC8.problem: Existing deep-research evaluations lack dedicated measures of which knowledge directions reports cover and how deeply they explore them.
qZcpegZiC8.method: An automated pipeline builds Wikipedia knowledge trees and samples subgraphs to generate queries and relation-grounded rubrics. Evaluation measures breadth and depth and combines them through their geometric mean.
qZcpegZiC8.key_idea: Map report evidence to knowledge-tree relations and aggregate coverage across branches and along chains.
qZcpegZiC8.evidence: Evaluation covers 16 agents on 144 cases across 24 domains with 44,102 rubrics, plus human-agreement and ranking-stability checks.
qZcpegZiC8.claimed_gains: The best-performing agent reaches 57.04% overall coverage.

fFcZzg7c2N.one_liner: GenStegoBench audits covert-message persistence across generative-image production, processing, and latent recovery.
fFcZzg7c2N.problem: Generated images can conceal messages that remain recoverable after lifecycle processing, creating persistent covert-channel risks.
fFcZzg7c2N.method: GenStegoBench evaluates hidden-channel reliability through the generation-channel-recovery lifecycle of diffusion and flow image systems. It examines generator backbones, solvers, encoding rules, and transformations that disrupt recoverable invariants.
fFcZzg7c2N.key_idea: Track covert-channel recoverability across generation, image transformations, and latent inversion to compare persistence and disruption mechanisms.
fFcZzg7c2N.evidence: Audits find amplitude rules more influential than bases, sample-correspondence transforms strongest among single-step disruptors, and residual risk after processing saturates.

C0PfDjbTzM.one_liner: DFLoRA decomposes degradation cues into reusable factors and combines dedicated low-rank restoration adapters using inferred composition weights.
C0PfDjbTzM.problem: All-in-one restoration models inadequately represent factor-specific behavior when multiple degradations co-occur.
C0PfDjbTzM.method: DFLoRA organizes latent degradation information into reusable factor representations and composition coefficients. Each factor has a dedicated low-rank restoration executor, and inferred degradation composition determines how the adapters are combined.
C0PfDjbTzM.key_idea: Translate inferred degradation-factor coefficients directly into a composition of factor-specific low-rank restoration adaptations.
C0PfDjbTzM.evidence: Experiments evaluate composite-degradation restoration and multiple single-degradation tasks in the standard all-in-one setting.
C0PfDjbTzM.claimed_gains: DFLoRA achieves a PSNR gain of 1.23 dB over the strongest competing method on the composite-degradation benchmark.

thHcQOYkUK.one_liner: SubjectSwitch rebuilds subject-related KV regions and corrects attention-sink leakage while preserving background cache during interactive video generation.
thHcQOYkUK.problem: Cached representations hinder subject replacement without background disruption, and persistent attention sinks can reintroduce obsolete subjects.
thHcQOYkUK.method: SubjectSwitch detects prompt-level subject changes and subtracts background attention to locate and reconstruct subject-related recent KV regions. It also estimates persistent attention-sink influence at selected blocks and denoising timesteps and corrects affected predictions.
thHcQOYkUK.key_idea: Reconstruct only subject-related cache regions under the new prompt and selectively correct residual subject cues from the attention sink.

FgDfnkBEzf.one_liner: SpecAgent lets a weak model draft grounded tool trajectories and a strong model verify entire segments in parallel.
FgDfnkBEzf.problem: Strong-model generation of every tool-use step wastes computation on routine actions, while stepwise verification limits speculative efficiency.
FgDfnkBEzf.method: A weak model executes read-only tools while drafting and pauses before an environment-changing action. A strong model verifies the segment in one forward pass, commits the longest semantically valid prefix, and repairs the first rejected step.
FgDfnkBEzf.key_idea: Draft tool-grounded read-only trajectories with a weak model, then verify their semantic validity through one strong-model prefill pass.
FgDfnkBEzf.evidence: Evaluation covers τ²-Bench, AutomationBench, and an edge–cloud MCP-Atlas deployment with three cloud models.
FgDfnkBEzf.claimed_gains: On τ²-Bench, SpecAgent comes within one point of the strong model's success rate while roughly halving memory traffic and wall time.

Y6s5gQi9lG.one_liner: ResOT repairs hallucination-related hidden states through Gaussian optimal transport within a localized residual subspace.
Y6s5gQi9lG.problem: Suppressing hallucination-related representation components can discard useful information and degrade vision-language capabilities.
Y6s5gQi9lG.method: ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace and aligns hallucinated and faithful distributions using Gaussian optimal transport in the residual subspace. At inference, it adaptively moves token states toward the resulting repair targets.
Y6s5gQi9lG.key_idea: Construct a residual hallucination subspace, align its distributions by Gaussian optimal transport, and adaptively move token states toward repair targets.
Y6s5gQi9lG.evidence: Experiments on three representative LVLMs assess object hallucination, image caption quality, and multimodal performance across multiple unspecified benchmarks.

Fh0NR6g8Hs.one_liner: PaperGym separates research questions from evaluation criteria and uses rubrics first for self-distillation, then reinforcement learning.
Fh0NR6g8Hs.problem: Research-plan training lacks verifiable answers, and generating questions and rubrics from the same content enables reward through paraphrase.
Fh0NR6g8Hs.method: PaperGym derives questions from goals and background while extracting methodological and experimental criteria from methods and experiments. Rubrics provide privileged context for an OPSD self-teacher before serving as GRPO rewards.
Fh0NR6g8Hs.key_idea: Separate question and criterion source sections, then use the rubric sequentially as privileged self-teacher context and reinforcement-learning reward.
Fh0NR6g8Hs.evidence: Experiments compare training schedules across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, five benchmarks, and fixed-recipe training on PaperGym-20k versus RubricHub Science.
Fh0NR6g8Hs.claimed_gains: Criterion leakage is 1.84% versus 7.00% to 43.41%; five-benchmark averages improve by +5.6, +5.0, and +4.8 points across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, and PaperGym-20k wins 58.1% of three-way comparisons versus 28.2% for RubricHub Science.

A74TiwMI64.one_liner: Group Causal Counterfactual Policy Optimization builds token advantages from rewards for counterfactual reasoning robustness and effectiveness.
A74TiwMI64.problem: Final-answer rewards undervalue sound reasoning with wrong answers and reward lucky guesses with flawed logic, limiting generalization.
A74TiwMI64.method: The method treats multiple reasoning candidates for a question as counterfactual experiments. An episodic reward combines answer-distribution stability under perturbations with sufficient variability for transfer, then supplies token-level advantages for policy optimization.
A74TiwMI64.key_idea: Convert counterfactual robustness and effectiveness of reasoning candidates into episodic rewards and token-level policy advantages.
A74TiwMI64.evidence: Experiments report advantages on diverse benchmarks, but the supplied text does not name datasets, models, or numerical results.

2RbeR6oAlx.one_liner: ConeNO restricts every neural-operator read, including attention-weight inputs, to the physical domain of dependence.
2RbeR6oAlx.problem: Global neural operators can depend on physically irrelevant exterior data, and masking after global mixing does not remove that dependence.
2RbeR6oAlx.method: ConeNO confines all reads to prescribed backward domains of dependence, including information used to determine attention weights. The paper proves closure under composition and analyzes the limits of Jacobian-based certification.
2RbeR6oAlx.key_idea: Restrict both feature reads and attention-weight construction to the prescribed physical domain of dependence at every layer.
2RbeR6oAlx.evidence: Matched-capacity and matched-supervision experiments use variable-coefficient transport and finite-volume Burgers flow maps, including exterior-data interventions.
2RbeR6oAlx.claimed_gains: ConeNO lowers error by 26–87% versus constrained convolutional and local-window Fourier operators, matches global FNO on transport, and reduces its Burgers error by 45–80%, with zero response to exterior interventions that increase global FNO error nearly tenfold.

cZbrB6cLEB.one_liner: GraftOOD inserts external video exemplars into rollout groups and trains with shared reward-rectification and exemplar velocity regression.
cZbrB6cLEB.problem: Video reward optimization can increase proxy scores while collapsing motion, even when using a video-level motion-quality reward.
cZbrB6cLEB.method: GraftOOD replaces some online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification and sequence-level exemplar supervision without exemplar trajectories or an extra supervised-loss coefficient.
cZbrB6cLEB.key_idea: Mix external exemplars into prompt-group rollouts and combine exemplar supervision with reward rectification in a shared velocity-regression objective.
cZbrB6cLEB.evidence: Wan2.1-1.3B experiments use GraftSet-Video's 9,588 exemplars for 2,397 prompts, compare three exemplar-augmented methods, and ablate exemplar frequency and count.
cZbrB6cLEB.claimed_gains: Relative to reward-only FlowAWR, Dynamic Degree rises from 4.86 to 44.41 while HPSv3 falls from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close; GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods.

XvpfCR9z5d.one_liner: VERIFYCOT checks selected visual evidence against hidden-state-derived requests and corrects mismatches before reasoning consumes them.
XvpfCR9z5d.problem: Interleaved vision-language reasoning consumes mismatched visual evidence, while later correction only partially repairs accuracy or discards prior reasoning.
XvpfCR9z5d.method: VERIFYCOT derives the current visual request directly from model hidden states and verifies selected evidence against it. Passing evidence is retained, while failing evidence is corrected before reasoning continues.
XvpfCR9z5d.key_idea: Verify selected evidence against a hidden-state-derived visual request and correct mismatches before the next reasoning step.
XvpfCR9z5d.evidence: Controlled evidence interventions and experiments across interleaved VLM architectures and five visual reasoning benchmarks compare pre-consumption checks with unconditional grounding and post-hoc correction.
XvpfCR9z5d.claimed_gains: VERIFYCOT improves end-to-end accuracy in 14 of 15 evaluated settings, with gains of up to 15.7 percentage points.

ewNGhiY5Mu.one_liner: ChainBench-ADD composes reproducible audio delivery chains linked to clean parents under fixed transcript and speaker conditions.
ewNGhiY5Mu.problem: Generation-centric audio deepfake datasets inadequately characterize accumulated delivery effects while controlling transcript and speaker differences.
ewNGhiY5Mu.method: The benchmark organizes transcoding, communication degradation, playback/recapture, and multi-hop effects into five delivery families using reusable operators and ordered templates. Delivered samples retain links to clean bona fide or spoof parents under controlled transcript and speaker conditions.
ewNGhiY5Mu.key_idea: Apply ordered delivery-operator chains to paired clean audio parents while holding transcript and speaker conditions fixed.
ewNGhiY5Mu.evidence: The release contains 941,201 waveforms from 55,813 parents and five protocol-aware tasks examining family difficulty, local edits, and accumulated delivery paths.

UkPe6Ut18a.one_liner: LongSpark conditions a block-diffusion drafter on fixed-size boundary, recent-window, and global-summary representations extracted from the target model.
UkPe6Ut18a.problem: Parallel drafters attending to the full prefix become increasingly expensive as context length grows.
UkPe6Ut18a.method: LongSpark combines a target boundary state, recent KV window, and incrementally updated global summary in a fixed-size multiscale context interface. The drafter maintains no separate KV cache, and target verification preserves the target output distribution.
UkPe6Ut18a.key_idea: Replace full-prefix drafter attention with a fixed-size interface containing boundary state, recent KV context, and an incremental global summary.
UkPe6Ut18a.evidence: Evaluations span multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions, including long-context tasks and measurements of output-token latency and drafter context state.

dZT4KIj5n0.one_liner: CompoSE alternates local part processing and global context aggregation to generate editable 3D objects from coarse geometric layouts.
dZT4KIj5n0.problem: Creating high-quality 3D objects with controllable, localized edits to individual parts remains difficult.
dZT4KIj5n0.method: CompoSE conditions a diffusion Transformer on spatially arranged geometric primitives and generates part-separated objects. Alternating local and global processing infers part semantics and symmetries without part-level text, supporting substitution, addition, deletion, and style-preserving resizing.
dZT4KIj5n0.key_idea: Alternate per-part processing with cross-part aggregation in a diffusion Transformer conditioned on coarse geometric part layouts.
dZT4KIj5n0.evidence: Quantitative and qualitative experiments compare guided synthesis and proxy-controlled editing with existing approaches and demonstrate several compositional editing operations.

RCQF7OZRsO.one_liner: CoSkill jointly trains reasoning and meta-skill agents on a shared backbone to adapt policies and hierarchical skills together.
RCQF7OZRsO.problem: Skill-based agent learning either separates skill evolution from policy optimization or fixes meta-skill workflows, limiting co-adaptation.
RCQF7OZRsO.method: CoSkill models a Reasoning Agent and a learnable Meta-Skill Agent as a cooperative team sharing one backbone. The reasoning policy uses retrieved task and child step skills, while task performance guides refinement of those step skills.
RCQF7OZRsO.key_idea: Jointly optimize a shared-backbone reasoning agent and meta-skill agent, using task outcomes to refine the step skills that condition actions.
RCQF7OZRsO.evidence: Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop compare skill-based and RL baselines and assess success, sample efficiency, and wall-clock efficiency.
RCQF7OZRsO.claimed_gains: CoSkill reaches success rates of 98.4\% on ALFWorld and 90.6\% on WebShop, respectively (+3.5 and +6.2 pp).

5C08wkwIrT.one_liner: PCMI debiasing and diversity-aware exploration redistribute self-distillation credit across equally correct reasoning paths.
5C08wkwIrT.problem: Demonstration-conditioned on-policy self-distillation can sharpen already-probable correct responses, limiting gains from additional reasoning rollouts.
5C08wkwIrT.method: PCMI Debiasing corrects demonstration-dependent preferences among equally correct responses. Diversity-Aware Exploration then assigns credit according to each correct path's marginal contribution to diversity, encouraging underrepresented solutions.
5C08wkwIrT.key_idea: Remove demonstration-induced preference sharpening among correct responses, then reward each path's marginal contribution to correct-solution diversity.
5C08wkwIrT.evidence: An idealized analysis shows cancellation of additional PCMI sharpening, and experiments across multiple unspecified datasets assess Pass@1 and Pass@k.

yN6auYZEgT.one_liner: A sparse latent movement codebook separates movement selection from fixed robot control, enabling adaptation through a lightweight prior adapter.
yN6auYZEgT.problem: Few-demonstration robot adaptation is difficult when task-specific movement selection and precise control are learned jointly.
yN6auYZEgT.method: A latent action model reconstructs actions from sparse combinations of shared codebook entries, a prior predicts movements, and an observation-conditioned policy executes them. Latent Override trains movement adherence with compatible donor movements, after which adaptation updates only the prior adapter.
yN6auYZEgT.key_idea: Encode actions as sparse shared movement codes, train control to follow donor movement conditions, and adapt only the movement-selection prior.
yN6auYZEgT.evidence: Using Cosmos-Policy, evaluation covers ten real-world base tasks and six few-shot adaptation tasks with full-model fine-tuning comparisons.
yN6auYZEgT.claimed_gains: Average success is 65.5\% across ten base tasks and 58.33\% across six adaptation tasks, versus 50.0\% for Cosmos-Policy and 55.0\% for $\pi_{0.5}$ under full-model fine-tuning.

L5yBt1BLsF.one_liner: PRISM refines fetal-ultrasound plane activation maps with query semantics and composes spatial predictions through expert and patch routers.
L5yBt1BLsF.problem: MLLMs lack fetal-ultrasound domain knowledge, while pretrained plane activation maps are too coarse and unstable for query-specific localization.
L5yBt1BLsF.method: PRISM supplies domain-specific visual features to the MLLM and learns residual corrections to plane activation maps using visual context and query semantics. It builds experts from the refined prior, features, and query, selects them with a Set Router, and spatially fuses predictions with a Patch Router.
L5yBt1BLsF.key_idea: Refine plane-level activation maps into query-conditioned priors, then select and spatially combine experts using set and patch routing.

Hn7G1NGzSB.one_liner: AV-TRACE tests modality judgments with matched audiovisual comparisons, while FQFT regularizes judgment margins across four target-presence states.
Hn7G1NGzSB.problem: Correct audiovisual answers can conceal incorrect modality judgments and instability when only the other modality changes.
Hn7G1NGzSB.method: AV-TRACE combines explicit modality judgments with matched audiovisual comparisons to test answer correctness, judgment correctness, and stability. FQFT augments GRPO with joint answer-judgment rewards and factorial regularization of judgment margins across four target-presence states.
Hn7G1NGzSB.key_idea: Evaluate matched audiovisual quartets and regularize modality-judgment margins across their four target-presence conditions alongside joint answer-judgment rewards.
Hn7G1NGzSB.evidence: AV-TRACE contains 7,344 test examples, and the supplied abstract describes FQFT evaluation on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B against supervised fine-tuning.

umYDfebPOg.one_liner: Behavioral comparisons, Transformer constructions, and causal probes identify finite-window computations underlying in-context hidden Markov model prediction.
umYDfebPOg.problem: The algorithms supporting pretrained LLM prediction of hidden Markov model observations remain unclear.
umYDfebPOg.method: The study compares behavior against candidate algorithms, relates their classes theoretically, and constructs Transformer implementations. Causal probing then identifies low-dimensional linear representations associated with these computations in pretrained LLMs.
umYDfebPOg.key_idea: Triangulate candidate HMM prediction algorithms through behavioral matching, constructive Transformer implementations, and causal interventions on internal representations.
umYDfebPOg.evidence: A small trained Transformer validates a finite-window mechanism, while pretrained-model probes across HMM regimes favor finite-window, gradient-descent-like computations in most regimes.

xgCSt7IRVo.one_liner: Delta-tau-Bench evolves executable tool ecosystems, and Steward adapts procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic tool provisioning.
xgCSt7IRVo.problem: Existing benchmarks do not jointly test efficient tool discovery and procedural-knowledge revision as tools disappear, change, or gain alternatives.
xgCSt7IRVo.method: The benchmark applies capability-preserving transformations to successive tool ecosystems while evaluating stateful, multi-turn tasks. Steward jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during execution.
xgCSt7IRVo.key_idea: Transform tool ecosystems while preserving capabilities, then maintain procedural skills incrementally and provision tools dynamically as tasks execute.
xgCSt7IRVo.evidence: Evaluation covers 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states, including skill-learning methods and Steward.
xgCSt7IRVo.claimed_gains: Even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3\% task success.

cJlLf6k9Vc.one_liner: LiTE performs multiple teacher-aligned latent updates per student transition using visibility-guided transport for LiDAR scene completion.
cJlLf6k9Vc.problem: Iterative LiDAR diffusion repeatedly evaluates the full backbone, while endpoint-only distillation discards intermediate geometric refinement states.
cJlLf6k9Vc.method: LiTE performs multiple teacher-aligned updates at a deep feature interface within each student transition. Visibility-Conditioned Latent Transport updates scan-to-point feature correspondences and uses sensor-ray visibility to guide local geometric refinement.
cJlLf6k9Vc.key_idea: Simulate multiple teacher-aligned geometric updates inside deep features, refreshing scan correspondences and applying sensor-ray visibility constraints without repeated full-backbone evaluations.
cJlLf6k9Vc.evidence: Experiments on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 compare Chamfer distance, JSD, and denoising time with few-step methods and the LiDiff teacher.
cJlLf6k9Vc.claimed_gains: LiTE reduces denoising time by $15\times$ relative to the 50-step LiDiff teacher.

N318SGLoK4.one_liner: Analysis of diffusion multimodal models motivates language-to-vision training that aligns visual states with question semantics.
N318SGLoK4.problem: Studies of causal-attention multimodal models primarily capture vision-to-language flow and overlook bidirectional integration mechanisms.
N318SGLoK4.method: The study examines full-attention diffusion MLLMs and finds shallow language-to-vision flow followed by deeper cooperation with vision-to-language flow. It introduces language-to-vision flow into autoregressive MLLM training to condition visual processing on the question.
N318SGLoK4.key_idea: Use language-to-vision information flow to align question-relevant visual states with semantics before subsequent vision-to-language transfer.
N318SGLoK4.evidence: Mechanistic analysis of diffusion MLLMs and training interventions in conventional autoregressive MLLMs assess information flow and vision-centric understanding.

XJjaWljscL.one_liner: TextReVision evaluates image text edits with sample-specific rubrics and scores whose quality contribution is gated by essential task completion.
XJjaWljscL.problem: Text recognition and image similarity fail to establish whether complex editing instructions satisfy textual, spatial, stylistic, and semantic intent.
XJjaWljscL.method: TextReVision provides bilingual scenarios with verifiable, sample-specific criteria across five capability families. Gate-and-Craft scoring bounds attainable scores by essential task completion and scales the contribution of execution quality.
XJjaWljscL.key_idea: Gate attainable scores and execution-quality credit by essential instruction completion using verifiable sample-specific criteria.
XJjaWljscL.evidence: Evaluation covers 1,200 samples, 16 scenarios, 6,426 criteria, eight dimensions, and 18 models in 21 configurations, with comparison to human scores.
XJjaWljscL.claimed_gains: Scoring concordance with human references is 0.935, leading Chinese/English scores reach 89.5/89.3, and SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MOT's thinking mode raises reasoning scores from 34.7/31.8 to 71.7/70.1.

eUe2HhQglz.one_liner: Randomized cardinal anchors and transfer matching identify priced-policy outcomes from a frozen local-disclosure log.
eUe2HhQglz.problem: Grouping strategic applicants by cost sensitivity can hide absolute stakes and default risks needed to evaluate fee- or subsidy-bearing policies.
eUe2HhQglz.method: Randomized cardinal anchors label outcome-relevant value-cost cells, and a common transfer shift matches the focal target transfer while preserving choices. Under selected-action transfer exclusion, Horvitz–Thompson moments estimate approval, risk, and value from one frozen log.
eUe2HhQglz.key_idea: Label value-cost cells with randomized anchors and shift displayed transfers to match target transfers before estimating outcomes with Horvitz–Thompson moments.
eUe2HhQglz.evidence: Theory characterizes identification, uniform evaluation of finite predeclared policy classes, structural extensions under rank and stability conditions, and minimax error in a coarse independent experiment.
eUe2HhQglz.claimed_gains: Direct labels improve minimax mean squared error from $\Theta((Npg^2)^{-1})$ to $\Theta((Npg)^{-1})$ in the coarse independent experiment.

MqC9SPsjt7.one_liner: Inference auctions allocate LLM service priority through bids, truthful pricing, and budget-constrained autobidding.
MqC9SPsjt7.problem: Coarse fixed-price service tiers cannot express users' different delay tolerances when inference demand exceeds capacity.
MqC9SPsjt7.method: The auction lets users bid for faster service and uses fast pricing algorithms that incentivize truthful bidding. An autobidding agent adjusts bids over time to maximize utility subject to a total spending budget.
MqC9SPsjt7.key_idea: Allocate inference priority according to bids with truth-incentivizing prices, while adapting bids over time under user-specified spending budgets.
MqC9SPsjt7.evidence: Experiments assess system welfare, cache utilization, and latency using the SGLang inference-serving framework.

zAw7gVhPnF.one_liner: FracGen jointly predicts fracture video and physical fields with consistency losses, trained on damage-aware material-point simulations.
zAw7gVhPnF.problem: Controllable fracture video generation must capture material-specific physical dynamics from an intact-object image.
zAw7gVhPnF.method: FracSim augments material point simulation with a continuum damage model to produce paired videos and pixel-aligned physical fields. FracGen jointly predicts RGB video and these fields, using physics-informed consistency losses and conditioning signals to control fracture behavior.
zAw7gVhPnF.key_idea: Jointly predict fracture video and dense physical fields from damage-aware simulation data while enforcing consistency among the predicted fields.
zAw7gVhPnF.evidence: A proposed fracture-video physical-plausibility benchmark and experiments compare physical and visual fidelity with existing video generation baselines.

8UJzSYuF9s.one_liner: Prox approximates SwiGLU intermediate-state channel rankings with sparse inputs and quantized proxies, then computes selected channels exactly.
8UJzSYuF9s.problem: Training-free FFN sparsification loses quality at high sparsity, while accurate intermediate-state channel selection requires expensive dense computation.
8UJzSYuF9s.method: Prox first estimates channel-salience rankings using input sparsity and quantized proxy weights to construct a mask. It then computes selected channels with full-precision weights, enabling sparse execution of all three SwiGLU projections without training.
8UJzSYuF9s.key_idea: Approximate only the intermediate-state magnitude ranking to select channels, then execute those channels exactly using full-precision weights.
8UJzSYuF9s.evidence: Evaluations across ten LLMs from six model families compare training-free baselines at varied sparsity levels and examine compatibility with quantization and sparse attention.
8UJzSYuF9s.claimed_gains: Prox achieves up to a $2.07\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup at 70\% FFN sparsity.

OplgHiAcOP.one_liner: Controlled assistant training measures user-simulator quality through downstream interactions with real humans.
OplgHiAcOP.problem: User-simulator quality lacks an established measure tied to the usefulness of assistants trained with those simulators.
OplgHiAcOP.method: The study varies only the user simulator while training assistants through reinforcement learning, comparing role-playing LLMs with simulators fine-tuned on WildChat utterances. Pairwise human preferences and WildBench measure downstream utility.
OplgHiAcOP.key_idea: Evaluate simulators by holding assistant training conditions fixed and measuring resulting assistant preferences in real-human interactions.
OplgHiAcOP.evidence: A controlled experiment uses a 283-participant user study and WildBench, with analyses of persona conditioning and simulator model size.
OplgHiAcOP.claimed_gains: Role-playing simulator training yields a 51% win rate against the initial assistant, while fine-tuned simulator training yields 58% against the initial assistant and 57% against the role-playing-trained assistant.

F08zncHhVc.one_liner: Language memories feed past driving observations back into a vision-language-action agent trained with separate memory and driving advantages.
F08zncHhVc.problem: Limited visual context prevents driving agents from reliably using past events such as arrival order at all-way stops.
F08zncHhVc.method: AD-Memo writes driving-relevant object memories as an extension of chain-of-thought reasoning and includes them in future inputs. Supervised fine-tuning precedes Da Capo reinforcement learning, which assigns trajectory-level advantages to memory and step-level advantages to driving.
F08zncHhVc.key_idea: Feed generated language memories into future driving decisions while separating trajectory-level memory credit from step-level driving credit.
F08zncHhVc.evidence: Experiments cover all-way stops and general driving, reporting improved driving quality and scene question answering.

6gB66dhByQ.one_liner: Singular-value decomposition separates latent reasoning directions and supplies geometric supervision for reasoning distillation.
6gB66dhByQ.problem: Outcome-only latent reasoning objectives provide little guidance to intermediate reasoning geometry and can produce ill-conditioned trajectories.
6gB66dhByQ.method: Compact singular-value decomposition separates latent reasoning chains into a principal direction and an orthogonal subspace. An auxiliary distillation objective aligns the principal direction with language chain-of-thought and uniformly expands the orthogonal component.
6gB66dhByQ.key_idea: Align latent chains with the principal direction of language reasoning while uniformly expanding their orthogonal subspace.
6gB66dhByQ.evidence: Theoretical and empirical analyses connect geometric components to reasoning logic and show intermediate-state convergence toward an ideal exit under outcome-rewarding objectives.

sozir2t8Z9.one_liner: An auxiliary denoising pass predicts subskill transition timing to condition longer robot action chunks.
sozir2t8Z9.problem: Long action chunks reduce inference pauses but accumulate errors around transitions between manipulation subskills.
sozir2t8Z9.method: RACE predicts within-chunk subskill transition timing through an auxiliary one-step denoising pass and conditions action generation on those predictions.
sozir2t8Z9.key_idea: Predict subskill switch times with one denoising pass and use those times to condition long-chunk action generation.
sozir2t8Z9.evidence: Action-error analyses and simulation comparisons examine chunk lengths, and real-robot experiments measure idle-time reductions.
sozir2t8Z9.claimed_gains: RACE surpasses compared VLAs with 2× longer chunks, remains competitive with 4× longer chunks, and reduces real-robot idle time by about 5× with 4× longer chunks.

7NxfU0c6KN.one_liner: Decomposing feature-attribution errors separates reference mismatch, expert approximation, and routing effects in routed predictors.
7NxfU0c6KN.problem: Local feature scores in routed models can disagree with the complete predictor's response to finite feature replacements.
7NxfU0c6KN.method: The framework decomposes frozen-route gradient-times-input errors into reference-origin mismatch, finite-step expert approximation, and finite routing contribution. It studies centering, affine experts, and complete differentiation as corrections while checking remaining finite-step errors.
7NxfU0c6KN.key_idea: Separate finite-replacement attribution error into reference-origin mismatch, expert approximation, and routing contribution under the original-route convention.
7NxfU0c6KN.evidence: Experiments cover ten tabular datasets, five seeds, four routed predictors, and an original-implementation SENN reproduction on three datasets.
7NxfU0c6KN.claimed_gains: Centering increases joint donor-replacement probability drops in 199/200 runs, and complete differentiation improves numerical-field sign agreement in 377/400 checkpoint–reference pairs.

vnYE7hZoKz.one_liner: Inverse-loop residual scaling accounts for correlated weight-shared updates and supports learning-rate transfer across loop counts.
vnYE7hZoKz.problem: Increasing Transformer loop counts destabilizes training and shifts optimal hyperparameters because repeated shared layers do not behave like independent depth.
vnYE7hZoKz.method: Loop-μP analyzes correlations between residual increments under weight sharing. For a single layer repeated N times, it derives 1/N residual scaling with a loop-independent learning rate and extends the analysis to repeated stacks.
vnYE7hZoKz.key_idea: Scale shared residual branches by the inverse loop count while keeping the learning rate independent of that count.
vnYE7hZoKz.evidence: An infinite-width analysis establishes the unique single-layer parameterization with stable forward passes and maximal residual-stream updates.

wN8reWAZmX.one_liner: Joint image-semantic transport accelerates flow matching while a detached semantic branch prevents gradient interference.
wN8reWAZmX.problem: Pretrained visual representations do not always resolve image-velocity ambiguity, and semantic prediction losses can interfere with image-backbone optimization.
wN8reWAZmX.method: JsFlow jointly transports image states and semantic variables from multiple pretrained encoders, accelerating semantic transport along the trajectory. A separate branch predicts semantic velocities from detached backbone features to block semantic-loss gradients from updating the image backbone.
wN8reWAZmX.key_idea: Accelerate joint semantic transport and predict semantic velocities from detached image-backbone features.
wN8reWAZmX.evidence: ImageNet 256×256 experiments evaluate JsFlow with LightningDiT-XL/1 and compare it with SiT-XL/2.
wN8reWAZmX.claimed_gains: JsFlow achieves unguided FID 5.91 after 50K iterations, outperforming SiT-XL/2 trained for 7M iterations with FID 8.30.

yp3P95iDoC.one_liner: Offline KV-cache optimization adapts reused contexts before future queries arrive, keeping model weights and cache length fixed.
yp3P95iDoC.problem: Test-time adaptation after a request arrives adds training latency that limits latency-sensitive serving.
yp3P95iDoC.method: DiaKV directly optimizes a reused context's KV cache offline through posterior maximization under a context-specific question-answer distribution. It expands 20 seed question-answer pairs per context into a larger training set without changing model weights or cache length.
yp3P95iDoC.key_idea: Optimize a fixed-length context KV cache offline against context-specific question-answer data while freezing model weights.
yp3P95iDoC.evidence: Experiments cover four long-context question-answering benchmarks and three 3–4B language models.
yp3P95iDoC.claimed_gains: DiaKV improves the primary macro metric in 11 of 12 model–benchmark pairs.

RyGA2MQMOk.one_liner: Dirichlet-modeled classifier evidence ranks spiking-transformer tokens through uncertainty aggregated across spiking steps.
RyGA2MQMOk.problem: Spiking transformers incur redundant multi-step token processing, while existing reduction methods overlook temporal class evidence in the frozen classifier.
RyGA2MQMOk.method: CETS models token-wise class evidence with a Dirichlet distribution and aggregates temporal uncertainty statistics into an inference-time ranking score. It reduces tokens without auxiliary predictors, training, or parameter updates.
RyGA2MQMOk.key_idea: Rank tokens using temporally aggregated uncertainty from Dirichlet-modeled class evidence produced by the frozen classifier.
RyGA2MQMOk.evidence: Experiments on static and neuromorphic benchmarks assess accuracy-efficiency trade-offs at controlled token-retention ratios and analyze representation-dependent uncertainty.

J7xtCcxdaC.one_liner: Lagrangian constraint propagation tightens neural-network verification over intersections of convex input constraints.
J7xtCcxdaC.problem: Abstract domains built for simple input regions produce loose bounds when practical inputs must satisfy additional convex constraints.
J7xtCcxdaC.method: CLAD propagates convex input constraints to compute sound network bounds over the true feasible region. It incorporates constraints into the objective with Lagrange multipliers and solves the resulting max-min problem using a projected primal-dual method.
J7xtCcxdaC.key_idea: Relax intersecting convex input constraints with Lagrange multipliers and optimize verification bounds through projected primal-dual updates.

aKcS8ZGDAR.one_liner: Task-name prompts drive synthetic image-question-answer generation and multimodal verification for visual-perception training.
aKcS8ZGDAR.problem: Natural-image datasets provide limited supervision for low-level visual skills such as spatial understanding and viewpoint recognition.
aKcS8ZGDAR.method: VisionFoundry uses an LLM to generate questions, answers, and text-to-image prompts from a task name, synthesizes images, and filters samples through multimodal verification. The resulting VisionFoundry-10k dataset supports supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
aKcS8ZGDAR.key_idea: Generate task-targeted visual question-answering examples from task names and retain them through multimodal verification.
aKcS8ZGDAR.evidence: Evaluations span 10 perception tasks and three open-source backbones, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, open-source synthesis, and self-verification.
aKcS8ZGDAR.claimed_gains: For Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, fine-tuning yields +6.7% on MMVP-pair and +10.5% on CV-Bench-3D.

AhE4zTUaSC.one_liner: Signed combinations of frozen reward-model scores correct hidden behavioral conflicts in preference labels before DPO training.
AhE4zTUaSC.problem: Preference labels can reward harmful compliance or sycophancy, creating alignment conflicts that explicit reward objectives need not share.
AhE4zTUaSC.method: CD-DPO learns a weighted combination of frozen reward-model scores from behavior-annotated examples and uses it to correct preference labels before standard DPO. Negative weights allow differences between reward scores to identify unwanted behaviors.
AhE4zTUaSC.key_idea: Learn signed reward-score combinations to identify unwanted behavioral incentives and correct preference labels before DPO.
AhE4zTUaSC.evidence: A stylized-model proof compares signed and nonnegative reward combinations at the same KL budget, and experiments cover Qwen2.5 and Mistral-7B.

rW1GsyaR8a.one_liner: Theory-guided decision agents and feature-selection agents jointly learn population-specific decision models through validation feedback.
rW1GsyaR8a.problem: Human decision modeling requires jointly choosing relevant information and behavioral assumptions because each determines the usefulness of the other.
rW1GsyaR8a.method: Niche Persona from Observation aligns population groups, visible features, and behavioral theories into decision niches. Decision agents learn choices under candidate theories while selection agents revise visible features using validation feedback and error patterns.
rW1GsyaR8a.key_idea: Jointly revise group-specific behavioral reasoning and visible feature sets using validation feedback.
rW1GsyaR8a.evidence: Experiments use three real-world datasets covering job choice, marijuana behavior, and alcohol behavior across multiple LLM backbones.
rW1GsyaR8a.claimed_gains: NPO achieves average relative F1 gains of 9.38%–10.24% over the strongest baseline for each dataset across all LLM backbones and reports using up to 43.75% fewer features.

yGpv1kD8y1.one_liner: Coupled solving and evolving loops turn video-agent capability gaps into executable tools through autonomous development and validation.
yGpv1kD8y1.problem: Effective long-video agents require costly manual tool design, while existing self-improvement methods offer limited or poorly convergent changes.
yGpv1kD8y1.method: VideoResearcher analyzes tool-use trajectories to identify capability gaps, then coordinates specialized agents to develop and validate executable tools. Its solving loop reuses these tools for subsequent evidence acquisition without updating model parameters.
yGpv1kD8y1.key_idea: Use tool-use trajectories to identify capability gaps, develop executable tools, and feed validated tools back into video reasoning.
yGpv1kD8y1.evidence: The abstract reports comparisons with self-improving agents and a human-designed upper bound but does not name datasets or models.

qmQJod1PoK.one_liner: Commitment–competence calibration attenuates retrieved memories that strongly steer agents but have low execution utility.
qmQJod1PoK.problem: Apparently relevant memories can repeatedly push multi-agent systems toward ineffective strategies despite low historical execution reliability.
qmQJod1PoK.method: C²Mem distinguishes memory commitment, the strength of behavioral influence, from memory competence, its reliability for successful execution. It dynamically attenuates relevant-looking memories with low execution utility.
qmQJod1PoK.key_idea: Calibrate memory influence against historical execution reliability and attenuate memories whose strong behavioral influence lacks reliable execution support.
qmQJod1PoK.evidence: The abstract mentions experiments across multiple benchmarks but truncates the results and does not name the benchmarks.

y2MmapOPNS.one_liner: Historical teacher trajectories and success-ratio constraints consolidate reasoning and long-horizon agency without new teacher inference.
y2MmapOPNS.problem: Repeatedly consolidating expert policies across student sizes is costly when each student requires live teacher inference.
y2MmapOPNS.method: HARP trains students offline from experts' logged RL trajectories, outcomes, and behavior probabilities, releasing experience according to teacher training stages. A success-ratio budget establishes a lower bound on task success whose floor remains non-decreasing for acquired tasks.
y2MmapOPNS.key_idea: Replay teacher histories along their training stages while constraining successful-trajectory ratios to maintain task-success lower bounds.
y2MmapOPNS.evidence: Experiments use Qwen3.5 at three scales, including same-size expert-student pairs and a 9B student trained from 27B histories on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
y2MmapOPNS.claimed_gains: HARP recovers 103.6–105.5% of single-task RL gains on same-size pairs and raises the 9B student's Terminal-Bench 2.1 score from 22.5% to 39.3%.

IrHouxtUsn.one_liner: Predictive KV retention and spatial compression preserve revisit-relevant history in autoregressive video world models.
IrHouxtUsn.problem: Sliding-window inference irreversibly evicts historical evidence needed to preserve scene identity when camera viewpoints recur.
IrHouxtUsn.method: WorldRetain trains a lightweight predictor using future attention and viewpoint reuse, then ranks resident history using observed camera geometry and cache features at inference. It compresses selected chunks into salient tokens and pooled summaries without changing generator weights.
IrHouxtUsn.key_idea: Predict future usefulness of resident KV chunks and compress selected history into salient tokens and pooled spatial summaries.
IrHouxtUsn.evidence: Evaluations use 100 RealCam-Vid camera-loop trajectories per backbone on LingBot-World-Fast and Matrix-Game 2.0.
IrHouxtUsn.claimed_gains: Compared with sliding-window inference, same-place scores rise from 1.77 to 2.29 and from 1.06 to 2.71, respectively, with 1.37–1.43× throughput speedups.

cHDRraZ0yR.one_liner: Fixed maintainer profiles evaluate frozen agent-written programs through downstream analysis, reuse, and testing tasks.
cHDRraZ0yR.problem: Correctness tests omit future maintenance difficulty, and self-maintenance evaluations confound code quality with the agent doing the work.
cHDRraZ0yR.method: CarryBench freezes repository-scale programs from nine producer models and evaluates three maintenance demands under fixed maintainer profiles. Observers predict behavior, consumer builders create new uses, and testers build black-box suites, alongside static modularity measurements.
cHDRraZ0yR.key_idea: Separate code producers from fixed downstream maintainers and measure distinct maintenance outcomes on the same frozen artifacts.
cHDRraZ0yR.evidence: The benchmark covers 13 cases in Python, Go, Rust, and C++, with nine producers, three maintainer profiles, and source-feature ablations.

kaRKugVrc5.one_liner: Pretrains a spatial transcriptomics foundation model via full-range spatial discrete denoising over a hierarchical cell-state vocabulary without cell ordering.
kaRKugVrc5.problem: Existing spatial transcriptomics pretraining methods either rely on fixed-rate masked reconstruction or impose unnatural autoregressive generation orders on unordered tissue cells.
kaRKugVrc5.method: Sudoku encodes single-cell states using a hierarchical discrete vocabulary and learns conditional distributions of hidden cell states given spatial context across the full masking range via spatial discrete denoising. This order-free conditional formulation unifies representation extraction under full or partial observation and multicellular spatial generation.
kaRKugVrc5.key_idea: Models conditional distributions of hierarchical discrete cell-state tokens given spatial coordinates across the full masking range via order-free spatial discrete denoising.
kaRKugVrc5.evidence: Pretrained on 49 million cells from 12 human and mouse organs and evaluated on niche retrieval, multi-scale clustering, spatial generation, and immune-recruitment prediction.

NBF6Dcm9Yx.one_liner: Post-trains flow-matching velocity predictors with auxiliary-code winner-take-all losses and auxiliary conditioning scaling to expand the quality-coverage frontier.
NBF6Dcm9Yx.problem: Flow matching collapses multiple valid targets for noisy intermediate states into a single mean velocity, while classifier-free guidance improves sample quality at the expense of mode coverage.
NBF6Dcm9Yx.method: During post-training, Competitive Flow Matching augments the velocity predictor with K randomly sampled low-dimensional auxiliary codes z per training example and applies the loss only to the best-matching velocity candidate. At inference, auxiliary conditioning scaling steers these specialized mode predictors alongside standard guidance.
NBF6Dcm9Yx.key_idea: Samples multiple velocity candidates conditioned on random low-dimensional auxiliary codes under a winner-take-all training loss and scales auxiliary conditioning at inference.
NBF6Dcm9Yx.evidence: Validated via post-training on ImageNet-256 using SiT and RAEv2 backbones.
NBF6Dcm9Yx.claimed_gains: Given less than 3% of original SiT pretraining compute on ImageNet-256, reduces FDᵣ,₆ from 19.22 to 5.91 at the 67% Recall point.

g0AInEyzuK.one_liner: Constructs morphology-consistent anchor-driven patch sequences and gates state propagation by spatial distance for pseudo-video whole-slide image segmentation.
g0AInEyzuK.problem: Pseudo-video whole-slide image segmentation methods treat gigapixel pathology patches as natural video frames, imposing false temporal smoothness priors across morphologically discontinuous tissue regions.
g0AInEyzuK.method: PV-WSI selects pathology-informative anchor patches to dynamically assemble morphology-consistent sequences without grid traversal bias via Adaptive WSI Pseudo-Video Construction. It pairs this with Distance-Constrained Gate State Propagation to transmit contextual states selectively while suppressing spurious long-range dependencies across weakly correlated regions.
g0AInEyzuK.key_idea: Assembles pathology-informative anchor patches into morphology-consistent pseudo-video sequences and attenuates recurrent state propagation across spatially distant or weakly correlated regions.
g0AInEyzuK.evidence: Evaluated across multiple magnification levels on computational pathology whole-slide tumor segmentation benchmarks.

t0qN4OHMql.one_liner: Combines GRPO outcome optimization with Fisher-regularized selective acceptance of signed token-level evidence-distillation corrections for LLM training.
t0qN4OHMql.problem: Sequence-level advantages in GRPO assign uniform credit across all tokens, whereas evidence-conditioned self-distillation transfers stylistic artifacts and miscalibrated teacher confidence that can destabilize training.
t0qN4OHMql.method: VERPO decomposes evidence-conditioned teacher guidance into an evidence-free reference term and signed token-level evidence corrections, using a stopped controller to selectively accept and scale updates by balancing local GRPO alignment against Fisher movement cost. Fisher Evidence Contrast (FEC) further attenuates nuisance shifts along an estimated evidence-presence direction via regularized projection.
t0qN4OHMql.key_idea: Decomposes evidence-conditioned teacher logits into a reference anchor and signed token corrections selectively scaled by local GRPO alignment versus Fisher cost and nuisance projection.
t0qN4OHMql.evidence: Evaluated across five scientific reasoning and tool-use tasks across language model families.

D1OtiCVcjn.one_liner: Reweights shared pre-generated LLM candidate pools for arbitrary test-time preferences using blockwise importance-weight normalization and robust aggregation.
D1OtiCVcjn.problem: Standard importance sampling over shared pre-generated LLM candidate pools requires bounded importance weights—rarely satisfied by language models—resulting in loose linear 1/δ sample-complexity bounds.
D1OtiCVcjn.method: POOLALIGN partitions a shared pre-generated candidate pool using blockwise importance-weight normalization to control extreme heavy-tailed ratios without boundedness assumptions, paired with robust cross-block value aggregation requiring only an evaluable proposal density.
D1OtiCVcjn.key_idea: Partitions shared candidate pools for blockwise importance-weight normalization paired with robust cross-block aggregation to control heavy-tailed density ratios without bounded-weight assumptions.
D1OtiCVcjn.evidence: Supported by uniform sample-complexity upper bounds achieving log(1/δ) rather than linear 1/δ failure-probability dependence, a nearly matching fixed-proposal lower bound, and experiments on heavy-tailed tasks and real LLM candidate pools.

GpB5sFHnTJ.one_liner: Characterizes residual target information and minimax sample-complexity rates for nuisance-eliminating calibration channels in Gaussian statistical inverse problems.
GpB5sFHnTJ.problem: Statistical inverse problems lack exact characterization of when and by how much auxiliary nuisance-only calibration measurements improve target recovery.
GpB5sFHnTJ.method: Studying a Gaussian inverse model with a mixed target-plus-nuisance acquisition channel and a nuisance-only calibration channel, the authors derive an exact operator-pairing formula separating irreducible structural loss from finite-calibration-budget loss. They prove minimax risk equivalence on compact convex target classes and derive matching minimax rates and calibration sample complexity under Hilbert-scale conditions.
GpB5sFHnTJ.key_idea: Quantifies post-elimination target information through cross-channel nuisance operator pairing, separating irreducible structural loss from finite calibration-budget error in coupled Gaussian inverse problems.
GpB5sFHnTJ.evidence: Theoretical analysis of Gaussian inverse problems proving residual information formulas, minimax risk equivalences for unrestricted and restricted nuisance classes, and matching Hilbert-scale minimax rates.

tYgoAokYzT.one_liner: Grounds multimodal LLMs in 3D space without architectural modifications by training them to predict decoupled spherical coordinates on SphereQA.
tYgoAokYzT.problem: Multimodal LLMs struggle with 3D spatial reasoning because added 3D encoders weaken general multimodal ability while answer-only spatial fine-tuning lets models exploit language priors without localizing objects.
tYgoAokYzT.method: After comparing four 3D coordinate representations across three MLLMs and finding decoupled spherical coordinates most effective, the authors generate SphereQA—a 300K-sample dataset of egocentric and allocentric spherical grounding annotations from 3D scans. They train an MLLM (SCOPE) on SphereQA to ground objects in spherical coordinates without changing model architecture.
tYgoAokYzT.key_idea: Fine-tunes standard MLLMs on 3D-scan-derived egocentric and allocentric QA pairs to localize objects in spherical coordinates that separate distance from angular direction.
tYgoAokYzT.evidence: Supported by a controlled comparison of four 3D location representations across three MLLMs and construction of the 300K-sample SphereQA dataset from annotated 3D scans.

LycBsXuKmv.one_liner: Combines token-selective on-policy self-distillation on majority-agreeing rollouts with grouped RL penalties on confident disagreeing tokens for label-free test-time training.
LycBsXuKmv.problem: Test-time training with majority-vote pseudo-labels is brittle because an incorrect majority vote corrupts the distillation teacher across every token.
LycBsXuKmv.method: Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO) exploits asymmetric pseudo-label reliability by distilling majority-agreeing rollouts via on-policy self-distillation (down-weighting already converged tokens) while penalizing confident errors in disagreeing rollouts via grouped RL.
LycBsXuKmv.key_idea: Exploit pseudo-label error asymmetry by distilling majority-agreeing rollouts at unconverged tokens while penalizing confident errors in disagreeing rollouts via grouped RL.
LycBsXuKmv.evidence: Evaluated without ground-truth labels on five competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks, Qwen3-1.7B test-time training, non-thinking modes, and cross-task transfer against label-supervised OPSD.
LycBsXuKmv.claimed_gains: Without labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, improves Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in test-time training, and gains +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking.

fsFWEkOmsI.one_liner: Trains an autoregressive speech-to-speech translator on scaffold-aligned duration-matched waveforms with curriculum learning and verifier-guided RL to preserve pause timelines.
fsFWEkOmsI.problem: Existing speech-to-speech translation models match semantic content, voice, or overall utterance length without aligning internal speech segments and pauses on a shared absolute timeline.
fsFWEkOmsI.method: TransDubber constructs 642K duration-matched English-Chinese speech pairs synthesized onto source-defined temporal scaffolds and trains an end-to-end autoregressive speech-to-speech model using a progressive supervised curriculum followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning.
fsFWEkOmsI.key_idea: Synthesize target waveforms on source-defined temporal scaffolds and train an autoregressive translator with a supervised curriculum plus verifier-guided reinforcement learning.
fsFWEkOmsI.evidence: Evaluated against Uniss on a 4,353-utterance English-Chinese test set covering both read and spontaneous speech.
fsFWEkOmsI.claimed_gains: On the 4,353-utterance test set, TransDubber raises translations within 2% of source duration from 25.6% to 61.5% and pause-alignment F1 from 0.118 to 0.550 over Uniss while maintaining competitive translation quality.

xCPp3uda32.one_liner: Replaces explicit 3D Gaussians with a scale-conditioned implicit decoder and epipolar detail aggregator for arbitrary-scale feed-forward novel view synthesis.
xCPp3uda32.problem: Feed-forward 3D novel view synthesis and super-resolution methods rely on explicit 3D Gaussians tied to fixed resolutions or require separate models per integer upsampling scale.
xCPp3uda32.method: Arbi3R encodes sparse low-resolution views with a Multi-View Geometry Encoder and renders continuous arbitrary-scale target views through an Implicit Function Decoder combining a scale-aware Coarse View Renderer, an Epipolar Dual-Stream Detail Aggregator, and a Coordinate-Modulated Neural Operator.
xCPp3uda32.key_idea: Decode multi-view scene tokens through a scale-aware coarse renderer, an epipolar detail aggregator, and a coordinate-modulated neural operator for continuous-scale rendering.
xCPp3uda32.evidence: Evaluated on RealEstate10K, ACID, and DL3DV against feed-forward 3D super-resolution baselines SRSplat and SR3R, including scales unseen during training.
xCPp3uda32.claimed_gains: On RealEstate10K, ACID, and DL3DV, Arbi3R outperforms SRSplat and SR3R by 0.8 to 2.2 dB.

30iIfyLndS.one_liner: Refines synthetic EEG generation strategies via closed-loop planner-evaluator feedback from downstream EEG foundation models and distills successful experiences.
30iIfyLndS.problem: Synthetic EEG generators optimize signal fidelity to real recordings rather than generating task-specific samples that improve downstream EEG foundation model adaptation.
30iIfyLndS.method: NeuroEvolve uses Closed-loop Strategy Discovery, where planner and evaluator agents iteratively refine EEG generation strategies using downstream foundation-model adaptation feedback, paired with Successful Experience Internalization to distill effective strategies for unseen tasks.
30iIfyLndS.key_idea: Use foundation-model adaptation feedback in a planner-evaluator agent loop to evolve synthetic EEG generation strategies and internalize effective policies.
30iIfyLndS.evidence: Evaluated across multiple downstream EEG decoding tasks, datasets, and EEG foundation models with ablations on strategy discovery and experience internalization.

1RC6rhOara.one_liner: Retains route planning alone as vision-language navigation policy context and repeatedly replans remaining subgoals to the final destination.
1RC6rhOara.problem: Including comprehensive reasoning traces such as scene descriptions and progress assessments in policy context degrades sequential vision-language navigation compared with compact planning context.
1RC6rhOara.method: Context-Think restricts execution-time policy context to planning and applies final-goal replanning at each update to regenerate a language plan covering all remaining subgoals from the current state to the destination.
1RC6rhOara.key_idea: Drop scene-description and progress traces from policy context and continually regenerate a language plan covering remaining subgoals to the final goal.
1RC6rhOara.evidence: Supported by component-wise reasoning-context ablations on matched trajectories and evaluated on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

kPZaBiizAj.one_liner: LLM-facing evidence distinguishability guides training-free visual-token preservation, grouping, and budget allocation.
kPZaBiizAj.problem: Visual-token pruning based on encoder importance can retain tokens that contribute little to the representation processed by the language model.
kPZaBiizAj.method: LAVIC measures how distinguishable local visual variations remain in the LLM-facing representation. It preserves informative tokens, groups redundant evidence around query-relevant anchors, and allocates budgets according to evidence concentration.
kPZaBiizAj.key_idea: Rank and compress visual evidence by its distinguishability after transformation into the language model's input representation.
kPZaBiizAj.evidence: Experiments span multiple vision-language models and benchmarks under aggressive token compression, including evaluation on LLaVA-v1.5.
kPZaBiizAj.claimed_gains: On LLaVA-v1.5, LAVIC retains 96.0% of the full-token performance.

4D9gkWAVWM.one_liner: Evolving semantic Gaussian primitives forecast occupancy at arbitrary times and support motion planning.
4D9gkWAVWM.problem: Fixed-step autoregressive world models limit temporal flexibility and make predicted scene evolution difficult to interpret.
4D9gkWAVWM.method: EvoWorld predicts compact 4D semantic Gaussian primitives from multi-view camera histories, including geometry, temporal support, and planar velocity. It splats primitives at independent temporal queries and decomposes velocity into ego-induced and object-level motion for occupancy forecasting and planning.
4D9gkWAVWM.key_idea: Represent the entire forecast horizon with time-conditioned semantic Gaussians that can be splatted independently at arbitrary timestamps.
4D9gkWAVWM.evidence: Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes and Occ3D-Waymo evaluate occupancy forecasting and open-loop motion planning.

rgKeEX38no.one_liner: Factorized static-dynamic memory grounds long-horizon video world models through training-free retrieval and injection.
rgKeEX38no.problem: Existing video-world-model memory either remains context-limited and entangled or accumulates errors in explicit global representations.
rgKeEX38no.method: GROME separates historical evidence into static scene geometry and dynamic entity states. It retrieves spatially aligned static history and recent dynamic states, then injects both through the model's native conditioning pathways without retraining.
rgKeEX38no.key_idea: Retrieve and inject static geometry and dynamic entity states separately to ground long-horizon video generation.
rgKeEX38no.evidence: Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios measure scene persistence, dynamic entity fidelity, and visual quality against existing methods.

1AAq0LUivN.one_liner: Prompt-conditioned scale-code decomposition recombines content and style for tuning-free personalized generation.
1AAq0LUivN.problem: Early visual autoregressive scale codes entangle content and appearance, limiting their use as separate personalization controls.
1AAq0LUivN.method: Kingfisher constructs neutral-style and object-content subspaces from prompt-guided predictions of a frozen generator and decomposes early residual scale codes. It recombines content from one image with style from another into a semantic prefix, then refines remaining scales through bitwise self-correction.
1AAq0LUivN.key_idea: Project early scale codes into prompt-derived content and style components and recombine them as a compact semantic prefix.
1AAq0LUivN.evidence: Experiments on CSD-100 compare content preservation, style and text alignment, and preparation time with diffusion methods and CSD-VAR.
1AAq0LUivN.claimed_gains: Kingfisher reduces preparation time by at least 55× compared with diffusion-based methods and by 10.5× compared with CSD-VAR on the same backbone.

8GdCvZpVP0.one_liner: Trust-region token supervision, outlier regularization, and teacher prefixes stabilize on-policy distillation.
8GdCvZpVP0.problem: On-policy distillation becomes unstable when teacher and student distributions differ enough to make token-level supervision unreliable.
8GdCvZpVP0.method: TrOPD restricts on-policy distillation to regions of reliable teacher supervision, regularizes rejected outlier tokens with negative top-k forward KL, and uses teacher-generated prefixes for off-policy guidance. These components address reverse-KL optimization under distribution mismatch.
8GdCvZpVP0.key_idea: Limit reverse-KL on-policy updates to trustworthy teacher-student overlap and regularize outlier tokens with forward-KL rewards.
8GdCvZpVP0.evidence: Experiments compare TrOPD with OPD, EOPD, and REOPOLD on mathematical reasoning, code generation, instruction following, and STEM benchmarks.

YP4r4SXdm4.one_liner: CKA-calibrated depth-stratified experts allocate shared and specialized capacity across EEG transformer layers.
YP4r4SXdm4.problem: Uniform adaptation in EEG foundation models does not address optimization conflicts and depth-dependent specialization across paradigms.
YP4r4SXdm4.method: PRiSE-EEG forms multi-channel patches from static cortical and network priors and dynamic channel interactions. It maps layer-wise CKA sharedness through a sigmoid to allocate shared and specialized experts across MoE Transformer blocks.
YP4r4SXdm4.key_idea: Use layer-wise representational sharedness to determine where mixture-of-experts capacity should be shared or paradigm-specialized.
YP4r4SXdm4.evidence: Gradient analysis across six downstream datasets and CKA analysis motivate the design, followed by experiments on 12 public EEG benchmarks and compact ablations.

pP6df7PZI7.one_liner: Evolves decomposed agent harness modules via benchmark-disjoint contrastive trajectory analysis across successes and failures.
