pP6df7PZI7.problem: Existing harness recursive self-improvement often overfits to evaluation benchmarks and entangles systematic harness flaws with instance-specific details.
pP6df7PZI7.method: ModularRSI contrasts successful and failed trajectories for the same task, aggregates recurring deficiencies across tasks, and attributes updates to five decomposed harness modules in a benchmark-disjoint setup.
pP6df7PZI7.key_idea: Decomposes agent harnesses into five modules and evolves them using cross-task contrastive analysis of successful and failed trajectories.

AtTwXA0210.one_liner: Empirically tests 17 orthogonality variants in LLM pretraining, finding gains stem from row-wise sphere optimization rather than orthogonality.
AtTwXA0210.problem: It is unclear whether orthogonality constraints, reported to aid LLM fine-tuning, also benefit large-scale LLM pretraining.
AtTwXA0210.method: They evaluate 17 orthogonality training variants and block-wise Stiefel constraints (block size d from 1 to matrix width) on decoder-only LLMs.
AtTwXA0210.key_idea: Varies row-block Stiefel constraint size d to show d = 1 sphere optimization matches or beats d > 1 orthogonality.
AtTwXA0210.evidence: Controlled decoder-only LLM pretraining experiments from 360M to 3.1B parameters trained on nearly 200B tokens, compared against tuned Muon optimizers.

BlWFQRu9f7.one_liner: Proposes SLRC, encoding low-rank affine response dependencies so MARL agents decode iterative refinement in one round.
BlWFQRu9f7.problem: Multi-round communication in cooperative MARL improves coordination under partial observability but introduces sequential communication latency.
BlWFQRu9f7.method: SLRC models coupled responses with rank-r interaction dependencies, sending compact (r^2 + r)-dimensional packets so receivers solve an r-dimensional linear system locally after one exchange.
BlWFQRu9f7.key_idea: Encodes rank-r affine response parameters into compact packets so receivers locally solve the linear system for iterative refinement.
BlWFQRu9f7.evidence: Theoretical equivalence proof under contraction plus experiments across 13 Cooperative Navigation, Predator Prey, and SMACv2 scenarios, FoV constraints, and Hallway tasks.

J18e1EO4UQ.one_liner: Proposes DP-lambdaCGD, correlating DP-SGD noise only with the prior step via PRNG regeneration to avoid memory overhead.
J18e1EO4UQ.problem: Matrix-factorization correlated-noise mechanisms improve DP-SGD accuracy but require storing past noise vectors, incurring substantial memory overhead.
J18e1EO4UQ.method: DP-lambdaCGD correlates noise solely with the immediately preceding iteration, cancels a tunable fraction of it, and regenerates the previous noise via a pseudorandom number generator instead of storing it.
J18e1EO4UQ.key_idea: Cancels a tunable fraction of PRNG-regenerated prior-step noise to achieve correlated-noise DP training at DP-SGD memory cost.
J18e1EO4UQ.evidence: Complexity analysis and empirical model-training comparisons against DP-SGD.

pJ3HyuQlhD.one_liner: Proposes OPR-BROS, a single-loop bilevel optimizer combining independent operator bi-sketching with Oja-learned principal-random factors.
pJ3HyuQlhD.problem: Exact single-loop stochastic bilevel optimization requires full-dimensional derivative computations, while naive randomized subspaces lack variance reduction from persistent directions.
pJ3HyuQlhD.method: OPR-BROS pairs independent input/output sketches for conditionally unbiased Hessian actions with a past-only Oja update for principal directions and a fresh random complement.
pJ3HyuQlhD.key_idea: Combines independent operator bi-sketching with past-only Oja principal subspaces and random complements for conditionally unbiased Hessian actions.
pJ3HyuQlhD.evidence: Theoretical convergence proofs (O(K^-1/2) squared-stationarity rate), small-task time-to-target benchmarks, and Pile-280M experiments over three seeds.
pJ3HyuQlhD.claimed_gains: On Pile-280M over three seeds, History and corrected BROS attain mean final upper-level losses of 3.1437 and 3.1525 at 0.3543 and 1.7104 seconds per optimizer step, respectively.

fvSJrQqZun.one_liner: Proves predictive latent SSL identifies stochastic prediction-relevant signals from unpredictable nuisance via mutual information and distribution matching.
fvSJrQqZun.problem: It is unclear how non-generative latent predictive SSL distinguishes stochastic variation in a true latent signal from unpredictable observation-private nuisance.
fvSJrQqZun.method: They formalize SSL as implicitly instantiating a latent-variable model with stochastic dynamics, proving predictive mutual information maximization and latent distribution matching together yield identifiability.
fvSJrQqZun.key_idea: Pairs predictive mutual information maximization with latent distribution matching to identify stochastic latent signals up to affine transforms.
fvSJrQqZun.evidence: Identifiability proofs and simulations with Gaussian predictors in dynamic nuisance-laden environments.

Av72ackUy7.one_liner: Co-evolves LLM-generated heuristics and a variable-pool RL selector in a closed loop using coverage-gap feedback.
Av72ackUy7.problem: RL-based heuristic selection scales efficiently over compact action spaces but hits a performance ceiling imposed by a fixed heuristic pool.
Av72ackUy7.method: CoEvoRL models heuristic selection as a restricted MDP whose suboptimality decomposes into an action-abstraction gap and finite-sample RL error. It alternates between training a variable-pool RL selector and using selector coverage-gap feedback to prompt an LLM to evolve complementary heuristics.
Av72ackUy7.key_idea: Alternating variable-pool RL selector training with coverage-gap-guided LLM heuristic generation breaks fixed-pool ceilings while keeping compact action spaces.
Av72ackUy7.evidence: Theoretical suboptimality decomposition in a restricted MDP and empirical combinatorial optimization experiments support the co-evolution loop.

xCYiobaQXx.one_liner: Transfers user source-domain preferences via LLM profiles and optimizes fuzzy retrieval queries using Monte Carlo tree search.
xCYiobaQXx.problem: User-side cold-start recommendation with ambiguous queries suffers from missing target-domain history, omitted preferences, and mismatched platform rankings.
xCYiobaQXx.method: LDCO builds domain-level and global user profiles from source-domain histories, maps transferable evidence to target attributes, optimizes query-generation prompts via MCTS with retrieval feedback, and reranks returned candidates.
xCYiobaQXx.key_idea: Combines source-domain preference profiling with MCTS-optimized query rewriting and profile-based reranking over an existing black-box retrieval interface.
xCYiobaQXx.evidence: Evaluated on a user-disjoint Amazon benchmark and under live Amazon retrieval.
xCYiobaQXx.claimed_gains: On the user-disjoint Amazon benchmark, raises Hybrid Hit@100 from 0.3169 to 0.4155, MRR@100 from 0.0365 to 0.0758, and NDCG@100 from 0.0872 to 0.1388; under live retrieval, raises Precision@15 from 0.2628 to 0.4162.

nKWxf15UzX.one_liner: Plans group merging and error-budget allocation using closed-form binomial certificate availability to maximize certified selective-prediction coverage.
nKWxf15UzX.problem: Certifying selective prediction separately across many fine-grained groups splits finite labeled data, leaving valid systems able to certify almost no traffic.
nKWxf15UzX.method: They define certificate availability—the probability a frozen predictor receives an exact binomial certificate—in closed form before drawing certification data. Using this quantity, they optimize how fine-grained classes merge into reporting units within fixed boundaries and allocate the familywise error budget toward low-traffic groups.
nKWxf15UzX.key_idea: Uses closed-form binomial certificate availability to merge classes and allocate familywise error budget preferentially to low-traffic groups before sampling certification data.
nKWxf15UzX.evidence: Evaluated on intent classification with fixed scenario boundaries and a preregistered evaluation on two untouched benchmarks, including a new image benchmark.
nKWxf15UzX.claimed_gains: Roughly doubles certified coverage at fine granularity on intent classification with fixed scenario boundaries.

NHe5VeJKMS.one_liner: Jointly trains conditional and unconditional diffusion branches on shared regression targets to preserve classifier-free guidance after post-training.
NHe5VeJKMS.problem: Existing diffusion post-training objectives optimize either the conditional branch alone or a fixed CFG output, leaving the unconditional branch underdetermined and degrading CFG.
NHe5VeJKMS.method: The authors formalize marginal closure between conditional and unconditional predictions under squared-error regression and introduce Marginal Closure Regularization (MCReg) to train both branches on shared targets. They derive reward-dependent targets for DiffusionNFT and apply conditional teacher targets to both student branches in on-policy diffusion distillation (OPD).
NHe5VeJKMS.key_idea: Trains both conditional and unconditional diffusion predictions on a shared regression target so the unconditional branch matches the posterior average of the conditional optimum.
NHe5VeJKMS.evidence: The paper derives marginal closure properties theoretically and evaluates MCReg across online RL and multitask on-policy diffusion distillation experiments.

hfcnZZ8Nf6.one_liner: Transforms existing signal measurements via known augmentation response laws to generate supervision targets for self-supervised representation learning.
hfcnZZ8Nf6.problem: Augmentation-based self-supervised learning creates transformed views without using predictable transformation effects on measurable signal properties as supervision.
hfcnZZ8Nf6.method: RePs (Response-law Privileged Supervision) analytically transforms existing measurements using known response laws to produce target labels for augmented signal views. The model learns measurement-relevant representations by predicting these transformed targets from the augmented signals alone.
hfcnZZ8Nf6.key_idea: Applies known analytical response laws to transform existing measurements into target labels for augmented views without extra annotation.
hfcnZZ8Nf6.evidence: Tested across temporal scaling in physiological signals (ECG, PTB-XL), pitch translation in music, and spatial rotation in multichannel audio, compared against SimCLR and untransformed supervision.
hfcnZZ8Nf6.claimed_gains: Lowers frozen-feature response error on unseen transformations by 7% for ECG timing and 26% for sound direction, and raises PTB-XL AUROC from 0.662 to 0.836 with 10% of downstream labels.

BogMmyGKy9.one_liner: Uses a VLM-generated grounded physical state graph to guide test-time optimization of frozen video diffusion models.
BogMmyGKy9.problem: VLM-planned video diffusion guidance consumes whole keyframes or trajectories from prompts, turning incidental visual details into optimization targets rather than local physical changes.
BogMmyGKy9.method: PhysPlan decomposes a physical phenomenon into physical deltas specifying object state changes and qualitative rules, translating them into a deterministically verified state graph. Graph-Guided Test-Time Optimization renders state keyframes and updates denoised estimates only on the properties and objects selected by the graph edits.
BogMmyGKy9.key_idea: Decomposes physical phenomena into verified state-graph edits and restricts test-time video diffusion updates to the edited objects and properties.

LaTkz3a69f.one_liner: Models patient physiology as system-organized latent states with treatment-conditioned transitions and local residuals for clinical trajectory forecasting.
LaTkz3a69f.problem: Clinical trajectory models often predict future states directly without explicitly modeling treatment-conditioned transitions or physiological system organization.
LaTkz3a69f.method: PatientWorld structures latent states by physiological systems, models generic treatments, cross-system effects, physiology-prior-structured treatment effects, and state-dependent transition residuals. After pretraining on ICU trajectories, pretrained dynamics stay fixed while downstream task-specific context adaptation specializes transitions.
LaTkz3a69f.key_idea: Organizes latent states by physiological systems with prior-structured treatment transitions and freezes pretrained dynamics during task-specific context adaptation.
LaTkz3a69f.evidence: Evaluated on multivariate trajectory forecasting across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV ICU datasets.

L9KtDDbUfr.one_liner: Applies direction-guided on-policy distillation that corrects preference-weakening deviations while preserving preference-strengthening ones under W4A4 quantization.
L9KtDDbUfr.problem: Full imitation of a BF16 teacher during on-policy distillation can unnecessarily correct quantization deviations that actually strengthen post-trained preferences.
L9KtDDbUfr.method: DQ-OPD supervises a W4A4 MXFP-quantized student on its own rollouts while selectively penalizing only teacher-student deviations that weaken post-training preferences.
L9KtDDbUfr.key_idea: Filters on-policy distillation updates to correct only quantization-induced deviations that weaken teacher preferences rather than enforcing full imitation.
L9KtDDbUfr.evidence: Evaluations on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B under MXFP W4A4 quantization against PTQ and QAD baselines.

Q58rPbzRQ3.one_liner: Anchors real-world robotic video prediction with randomized Isaac Sim digital-twin rollouts as in-context references for staged planning.
Q58rPbzRQ3.problem: Data-driven action-conditioned video predictors suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon robotic manipulation.
Q58rPbzRQ3.method: VPTwin reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration via a VLM, simulates randomized Isaac Sim rollouts under candidate actions, and conditions real-domain video prediction on them before a staged planner verifies VLM-proposed actions.
Q58rPbzRQ3.key_idea: Uses randomized physics rollouts from a VLM-reconstructed Isaac Sim twin as in-context references to ground real-domain video prediction and planning.
Q58rPbzRQ3.evidence: Evaluated on video prediction hallucination metrics and real-robot manipulation planning against simulation-only planners.

UMpbvdNhxd.one_liner: Models LLM multi-agent debate outcomes as a GNN-approximated mixture-of-experts over initial beliefs shaped by confidence and alignment.
UMpbvdNhxd.problem: It is unclear which agents gain influence during non-linear LLM multi-agent deliberation and how initial beliefs determine final votes.
UMpbvdNhxd.method: The authors show final multi-agent votes are captured by a mixture-of-experts linearly aggregating initial beliefs, with routing under the Friedkin-Johnsen model approximated from initial beliefs by a graph neural network.
UMpbvdNhxd.key_idea: Approximates multi-agent deliberation routing from initial beliefs using a GNN-parameterized mixture-of-experts conditioned on confidence and initial alignment.
UMpbvdNhxd.evidence: Empirical modeling of LLM multi-agent deliberation outcomes and influence allocation using mixture-of-experts and GNN approximations.

IllcopEYMs.one_liner: Aligns multimodal knowledge editing with autoregressive generation using simulated prefixes and a selective prefix loss.
IllcopEYMs.problem: In multimodal knowledge editing, teacher-forcing training selects parameters that fail to activate reliably during autoregressive generation due to routing mismatch.
IllcopEYMs.method: They formulate knowledge editing as a sequential decision process over simulated generation prefixes and introduce a Generation-Aligned Prefix (GAP) loss that propagates gradients only along valid tokens.
IllcopEYMs.key_idea: Simulates generation prefixes during editing optimization and restricts gradient propagation to valid tokens via Generation-Aligned Prefix loss.
IllcopEYMs.evidence: Experiments on VLKEB and ComprehendEdit under both single-edit and lifelong-edit settings.

xuisK3b8kZ.one_liner: Builds a benchmark and sandboxed MCP-tool RL environment for training multimodal agents to construct interactive 3D open worlds.
xuisK3b8kZ.problem: Existing 3D scene generation evaluations use idealized simple queries and lack an open-source environment to analyze and train multimodal agents.
xuisK3b8kZ.method: VIBEWORLDING pairs VWE-BENCH (2,616 3D assets, 323 seed worlds, and 6,828 reverse-synthesized multimodal queries) with VIBEWORLDING-GYM, a multimodal RL post-training framework. The gym unifies asset retrieval, editing, and rendering as MCP tools and scores outputs via a rubric-based verifier checking physical feasibility and intent fulfillment.
xuisK3b8kZ.key_idea: Unifies 3D asset retrieval, editing, and rendering as MCP tools inside an RL gym with a physical-feasibility and intent-fulfillment rubric verifier.
xuisK3b8kZ.evidence: Benchmarks frontier MLLMs and RL post-training on VWE-BENCH across verified and rubric-evaluated queries.

uiX7AEUu9T.one_liner: Evolves reusable multi-step problem decompositions and subproblem instructions via genetic search for frozen small language models.
uiX7AEUu9T.problem: Prompt-level distillation struggles on complex multi-step reasoning tasks that exceed what a small frozen student model can solve in a single call.
uiX7AEUu9T.method: EvoScaffold jointly evolves problem decomposition programs and subproblem instructions through genetic search without updating student parameters. Teacher revisions are guided by student execution traces, and selected strategies are reused on unseen task instances without teacher access.
uiX7AEUu9T.key_idea: Uses genetic search over teacher-revised decomposition programs and subproblem instructions to distill reusable multi-call reasoning scaffolds for frozen students.
uiX7AEUu9T.evidence: Evaluated across four reasoning tasks and four frozen student model sizes.

MmXhXHJGrr.one_liner: Encodes target history into a state and uses joint multivariate histories to select a replaceable latent action for forecasting.
MmXhXHJGrr.problem: Multivariate forecasters typically leave context-induced forecast revisions unlocalized rather than isolating the effect of surrounding variables.
MmXhXHJGrr.method: ACT separates a target-history state representation from a replaceable latent action selected using joint histories, which updates the state before a shared forecast head. Realized via the Latent Action Block (LAB) or direct scaling, it supports fixed-state intervention and exact replay.
MmXhXHJGrr.key_idea: Decomposes multivariate forecasting into a target-history state and a replaceable latent action conditioned on joint histories for interventional replay.
MmXhXHJGrr.evidence: Evaluated across 20 models on four datasets, five Solar sites (2,527 pairs), and 12 forecasters across eight benchmarks.
MmXhXHJGrr.claimed_gains: Across five Solar sites, observed-context actions lower 6-hour MSE by 28.0% relative to target-matched substitutions.

Rvi5CFmPBb.one_liner: Routes evidence from both failed and successful agent runs to diagnose and repair latent harness defects.
Rvi5CFmPBb.problem: Failure-gated debugging of LLM-agent harnesses misses abnormal evidence hidden in successful runs (L2) and latent defects requiring targeted activation (L3).
Rvi5CFmPBb.method: Proactive Invariant Harness Tomography (Proactive IHT) routes evidence from both failed and successful executions, selectively activates healthy candidates to expose L3 defects, and couples multi-view source-grounded diagnosis with intervention-supported repair.
Rvi5CFmPBb.key_idea: Extends harness debugging beyond failed trajectories by routing L2/L3 evidence from successful runs and coupling multi-view localization with intervention-verified repair.
Rvi5CFmPBb.evidence: Analyzes 9,045 labeled records from 16 open-source projects, 36 reconstructed defects, AppWorld edits, and four public benchmarks across four backbones.
Rvi5CFmPBb.claimed_gains: 25.1% of 9,045 records fall into L2/L3; Proactive IHT improves task completion over HarnessFix across all 16 settings by 2.0-5.0 percentage points (3.6 average) and passes 27/27 targeted checks in AppWorld.

hvN9PUG7VG.one_liner: Plans symbolic alpha formula construction using model-predictive prefix lookahead coupled with exact grammar transitions.
hvN9PUG7VG.problem: Symbolic alpha-factor formulas only yield performance feedback once completed, leaving intermediate construction steps without direct evaluation signals.
hvN9PUG7VG.method: AlphaDreamer trains predictive models on evaluated formulas to forecast prefix representations and completion quality. Its Model-Predictive Prefix Planner (MPPP) combines exact grammar transitions, learned lookahead, and a direct prefix scorer, executing the first action before replanning.
hvN9PUG7VG.key_idea: Couples exact grammar transitions with learned prefix-completion quality models for receding-horizon model-predictive prefix planning.
hvN9PUG7VG.evidence: Evaluated against 10 baselines on predictive accuracy and portfolio performance, plus ablations comparing full planning against direct prefix scoring.

49tGMi9369.one_liner: Retains frozen per-domain LoRA updates with layer-wise second-moment and scatter statistics for exemplar-free lifelong person re-identification.
49tGMi9369.problem: Exemplar-free lifelong person re-identification struggles to preserve prior-domain knowledge without storing images or relying on current inputs to activate old behaviors.
49tGMi9369.method: KPKW saves each domain's learned transformations as frozen LoRA updates alongside layer-wise input second moments and between-class scatter matrices without storing samples. These statistics guide historical response preservation and identity-related optimization when the frozen updates are jointly applied in a unified encoder.
49tGMi9369.key_idea: Stores frozen per-domain LoRA updates paired with layer-wise input second moments and between-class scatter statistics to coordinate exemplar-free lifelong adaptation.

ZyQP94WiEt.one_liner: Predicts per-pixel mixture-density depth hypotheses and probabilities to eliminate flying-point artifacts at object boundaries.
ZyQP94WiEt.problem: Single-depth-per-pixel estimators average foreground and background depths at object boundaries, creating spurious floating 3D points in empty space.
ZyQP94WiEt.method: MDA replaces single-value depth prediction with a mixture-density representation that outputs multiple depth hypotheses and associated probabilities per pixel, selecting a decoded depth from one hypothesis rather than interpolating between surfaces. It also extends to multi-layer transparent objects and unbounded sky regions.
ZyQP94WiEt.key_idea: Models per-pixel depth as a multi-hypothesis mixture density and decodes from a single selected component instead of averaging across boundaries.
ZyQP94WiEt.evidence: Evaluations across multiple depth estimation architectures, including under severe input blur, transparent objects, and sky regions.

Ffkpe2x2Bf.one_liner: Formulates molecular out-of-distribution detection as post-hoc preference optimization ranking in-distribution molecules over OOD ones.
Ffkpe2x2Bf.problem: Molecular foundation models behave unpredictably on out-of-distribution molecules, limiting their reliability in safety-critical discovery.
Ffkpe2x2Bf.method: Mole-PAIR attaches a plug-and-play module to frozen molecular foundation model representations and trains it via post-hoc preference optimization that ranks in-distribution samples above OOD samples, adaptively prioritizing hard pairs.
Ffkpe2x2Bf.key_idea: Applies post-hoc preference optimization on frozen molecular representations to rank in-distribution molecules over OOD ones while prioritizing hard pairs.
Ffkpe2x2Bf.evidence: Evaluations on molecular foundation models across OOD benchmarks under scaffold, assay, and molecular-size shifts.
Ffkpe2x2Bf.claimed_gains: Achieves up to 9.7% AUROC improvement and 48.5% FPR95 reduction over OOD detection baselines.

22yZyglymF.one_liner: Sequence-level rejection of routing-disagreeing responses limits off-policy drift without replaying rollout expert choices.
22yZyglymF.problem: Rollout-training mismatch changes MoE routing decisions, while routing replay removes gradient contributions from experts chosen only by the training router.
22yZyglymF.method: RDC treats rollout-training routing disagreement as an off-policy staleness signal and selectively rejects high-drift responses at sequence level. Retained responses preserve native training-router expert selections and can be combined with Truncated Importance Sampling.
22yZyglymF.key_idea: Filter whole responses by router disagreement to remove stale high-drift updates while preserving native expert gradients on retained data.
22yZyglymF.evidence: Experiments vary policy staleness and evaluate asynchronous RL, including RDC combined with TIS on AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 against TIS and R3.
22yZyglymF.claimed_gains: In asynchronous training, RDC with TIS improves average peak validation accuracy across AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 by 5.5 points over TIS and 4.5 points over R3.

Iih0nVVzPx.one_liner: Robot-trajectory language supervision gradually adapts VLMs to action policies while retaining pretrained representations.
Iih0nVVzPx.problem: Direct VLM-to-VLA fine-tuning must simultaneously cross visual-distribution and learning-objective gaps, which can degrade pretrained generalization.
Iih0nVVzPx.method: Embodied trajectory-coupled data supplies vision-language supervision from the same robot scenes and trajectories used for action learning. Distribution Bridging, Objective Bridging, and Retentive Adaptation sequentially adapt semantics, shift toward action prediction, and specialize for deployment.
Iih0nVVzPx.key_idea: Interpose language supervision coupled to robot trajectories between VLM pretraining and action fine-tuning to separate distribution and objective adaptation.
Iih0nVVzPx.evidence: The supplied abstract describes the three-stage recipe and data mixing but truncates before reporting evaluation settings or results.

Zlalazq09X.one_liner: Per-token likelihood ratios measure whether user-specific adaptation reduces surprisal on held-out user text.
Zlalazq09X.problem: Task performance, stylistic resemblance, and automatic judgments do not directly test whether conditioning helps a model anticipate its target user.
Zlalazq09X.method: LIFT computes a length-normalized per-token log-likelihood-ratio improvement over a generic baseline on held-out user text. ESS-LIFT downweights rare high-leverage tokens, and construct-validity stress tests examine identity sensitivity, fluency confounds, and mechanism ranking.
Zlalazq09X.key_idea: Define personalization as user-conditioned surprisal reduction relative to a generic baseline with fixed task, tokenizer, and base model.
Zlalazq09X.evidence: Construct-validity stress tests assess user identity beyond contextual relevance, generic fluency and raw-likelihood confounds, rare-token sensitivity, and rankings across personalization mechanisms.

uZBbCDPLaX.one_liner: An evidence-sufficiency router stops after shared retrieval or continues anchored memory expansion without restarting search.
uZBbCDPLaX.problem: Lightweight retrieval can miss dispersed evidence, while full memory reconstruction wastes computation when retrieved context already suffices.
uZBbCDPLaX.method: Router-Mem learns a single-token stop-or-continue decision using binary evidence-retention/removal supervision and rationale-conditioned representation distillation. Continuation expands retrieval-hit anchors, analyzes memory in parallel, and aggregates results without restarting search.
uZBbCDPLaX.key_idea: Train a router to distinguish evidence sufficiency from relevance by removing supporting evidence and discarding negatives that remain answerable.
uZBbCDPLaX.evidence: Evaluation with DeepSeek-V4-Flash at threshold 0.5 reports AMA-Bench and BEAM scores and online memory-processing time relative to full completion.
uZBbCDPLaX.claimed_gains: With DeepSeek-V4-Flash at a routing threshold of 0.5, Router-Mem reduces online memory-processing time by 27.3% on AMA-Bench and 25.5% on BEAM relative to full completion, scoring 55.17% and 38.77%, respectively.

NH0KjaJepH.one_liner: Geometric contraction moves doubly stochastic stream-mixing matrices away from Birkhoff-polytope vertices and over-mixing.
NH0KjaJepH.problem: Manifold-constrained hyper-connections can leave residual streams nearly independent near polytope vertices or indistinguishable near the uniform barycenter.
NH0KjaJepH.method: cmHC geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior while keeping mixing matrices exactly doubly stochastic. It uses moderate contraction in shallow layers to limit over-mixing and deeper exploration elsewhere to reduce under-mixing.
NH0KjaJepH.key_idea: Contract the feasible Birkhoff polytope so stream-mixing matrices avoid vertex-dominated under-mixing without collapsing to uniform over-mixing.
NH0KjaJepH.evidence: Theory bounds cumulative residual mixing, stream difference, and gradient difference across layers, with experiments on GPT-2 and Mixture-of-Experts at 6B and 300B parameter scales.

ptVs5u5q2b.one_liner: Uses a progress-paced Gaussian prompt curriculum over estimated pass rates to avoid zero-variance groups in GRPO.
ptVs5u5q2b.problem: Zero-variance prompts where all rollouts get identical rewards produce zero advantages in GRPO while wasting generation budget.
ptVs5u5q2b.method: OAGS estimates per-prompt pass rates from outcome rewards, draws candidate prompts from a Gaussian proposal centered on a progress-paced target pass rate, and selects non-zero-variance groups without altering GRPO's advantage estimator or clipped objective.
ptVs5u5q2b.key_idea: Gaussian prompt proposals centered on a progress-paced target pass rate reallocate GRPO rollout budget toward prompts likely to yield non-zero-variance reward groups.
ptVs5u5q2b.evidence: Evaluated across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks against standard GRPO, Dynamic Sampling, and GRESO.

vINo6SRiV2.one_liner: Transfers single-cell transcriptomic supervision to H&E-only patch cell phenotyping via two-stage decoupled alignment and count-guided flow.
vINo6SRiV2.problem: Morphology-only H&E cell phenotyping lacks molecular grounding, while molecularly supervised methods require cropped or prelocalized cells rather than raw pathology patches.
vINo6SRiV2.method: ViO-Align first aligns matched H&E cell crops and transcriptomic profiles via morphology-conditioned gene gating, then localizes cells on raw H&E patches using count-guided flow with center-masked microenvironment aggregation, transferring Stage-I molecular supervision across stages so inference requires only H&E images.
vINo6SRiV2.key_idea: Decoupled two-stage cross-stage alignment transfers morphology-conditioned gene-gated transcriptomic supervision from cell crops to raw-patch count-guided localization and center-masked microenvironment features.
vINo6SRiV2.evidence: Evaluated across four established cell phenotyping benchmarks against strictly test-disjoint baselines.

01hZuBp7qm.one_liner: Probes frozen pretrained video foundation models to measure intrinsic surface material recoverability versus image features.
01hZuBp7qm.problem: It is unclear whether general-purpose video foundation models encode intrinsic surface material properties without explicit material supervision.
01hZuBp7qm.method: The authors apply a lightweight probing framework to intermediate representations of frozen pretrained video foundation models, comparing material recovery against image features such as DINOv2 while ablating feature sources, viewpoint coverage, and object semantics.
01hZuBp7qm.key_idea: Lightweight linear/shallow probing of frozen intermediate representations quantifies how well pretrained video foundation models encode intrinsic material cues across viewpoints.
01hZuBp7qm.evidence: Probing experiments and ablations across synthetic and real-world scenes comparing VidFM features against DINOv2, plus qualitative synthetic-to-real evaluations.

yQFn1sDFa8.one_liner: Combines a Spiking Mixture-of-Experts with staged sensor-availability routing curriculum for resilient multimodal 3D occupancy prediction.
yQFn1sDFa8.problem: Multimodal 3D occupancy predictors degrade under missing sensors, and discrete spiking neural networks are difficult to optimize for resilient multimodal fusion.
yQFn1sDFa8.method: SpikeOcc pairs a Spiking Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with separate RGB, LiDAR, and joint pathways plus a bounded residual, trained under Sensor Availability Learning (SAL), a staged curriculum with explicit routing supervision.
yQFn1sDFa8.key_idea: Specialized RGB, LiDAR, and fusion spiking expert pathways with bounded residuals are trained via a staged sensor-availability curriculum with explicit routing supervision.
yQFn1sDFa8.evidence: Evaluated on multimodal 3D occupancy prediction benchmarks under full-sensor and sensor-outage conditions, including applying SAL to conventional models.

MhMgSrAXQS.one_liner: Fits an advantage-weighted diffusion policy prior to lazily cached MPC realizations to reduce actor divergence in planning RL.
MhMgSrAXQS.problem: Gaussian policy priors in model predictive control cannot capture non-Gaussian stochastic planner action distributions, causing actor divergence that biases value estimates.
MhMgSrAXQS.method: DPMPC stores multiple recent MPC action realizations per replay state via generalized lazy reanalyze without rerunning MPC at every update, and trains a diffusion policy prior on them using an advantage-weighted score-matching objective.
MhMgSrAXQS.key_idea: Advantage-weighted score matching trains a diffusion policy prior on multiple cached MPC realizations per replay state, matching non-Gaussian planner distributions without per-update replanning.
MhMgSrAXQS.evidence: Evaluated across 14 continuous-control tasks from DMControl, MyoSuite, and HumanoidBench against Gaussian-prior MPC baselines.

KZFiecIWef.one_liner: Couples iterative verify-and-refine latent state updates with differentiable polynomial rule extraction for abstract visual reasoning.
KZFiecIWef.problem: Existing abstract visual reasoning models encode induced relations implicitly in network weights, making them unobservable, unverifiable, and brittle out of distribution.
KZFiecIWef.method: NExRI couples IVaR, which iteratively refines contextual latent states by predicting the third panel from the first two and correcting discrepancies, with RaXO, which converts those states into explicit differentiable polynomial rule equations validated and executed on candidate completions.
KZFiecIWef.key_idea: Iterative verify-and-refine contextual state construction feeds an end-to-end differentiable module that fits, validates, and executes explicit polynomial rule equations over neural features.
KZFiecIWef.evidence: Evaluated across multiple abstract visual reasoning benchmarks (specific benchmark names and numbers not stated in abstract).

11iFrId04e.one_liner: Recovers missing views in multi-view clustering via structure decoupling, target-aware anchor retrieval, and confidence-guided graph interventions.
11iFrId04e.problem: Existing incomplete multi-view clustering methods ignore target-view distributions, underuse cross-view sample structure, and lack reliability checks when fusing recovered views.
11iFrId04e.method: TIGER learns view-specific latent representations that separate transferable from view-dependent information to build cross-view relationships. It then recovers missing views by retrieving informative anchors from observed target-view samples and applies confidence-guided graph interventions.
11iFrId04e.key_idea: Decouples transferable and view-dependent latent structures to retrieve target-view anchors and apply confidence-guided graph interventions for missing-view recovery.

MmC81fxkLB.one_liner: Benchmarks autonomous multi-object embodied search and stop decisions alongside a VLM baseline with interactive 3D memory.
MmC81fxkLB.problem: Existing embodied navigation benchmarks prescribe goal sequences or task lengths, leaving target selection and autonomous stopping underexplored.
MmC81fxkLB.method: The authors introduce MOST-Bench with Many-Object Navigation and All-Object Navigation tasks requiring instance selection, progress tracking, and stop decisions. They also propose MOST-Nav, a training-free baseline combining VLM decision-making with interactive 3D memory reconstructed from RGB observations.
MmC81fxkLB.key_idea: Pairs a VLM decision-maker with RGB-reconstructed interactive 3D memory and benchmarks autonomous visit-order and stopping decisions.
MmC81fxkLB.evidence: Evaluates seven training-based and training-free frameworks on 750 episodes across 36 HM3D scenes covering five task-modality combinations with 2–10 targets per episode.
MmC81fxkLB.claimed_gains: The best-performing method achieves an overall success rate below 18% on MOST-Bench.

0VS8HvxJyN.one_liner: Benchmarks omni models on adapting urban walking trajectories in response to spatial environmental sounds in CARLA.
0VS8HvxJyN.problem: Outdoor navigation emphasizes vision or destination-cue audio, leaving unstudied how environmental sound should trigger local route adjustments toward an independent goal.
0VS8HvxJyN.method: HearVGo augments CARLA with 1,288 spatialized environmental sound clips and human walking demonstrations to form 536 trajectory instances where models must either adapt or preserve a path. Models are tested zero-shot alongside controlled audio, vision, and left-right channel-swap ablations.
0VS8HvxJyN.key_idea: Tests whether omni models adapt or preserve walking waypoints from spatialized CARLA environmental audio and channel-swap ablations.
0VS8HvxJyN.evidence: Evaluates 14 omni models zero-shot on 536 CARLA trajectory instances with audio, vision, and left-right channel-swap ablations.

qsl2Sry3B2.one_liner: Audits linear representation erasure by calibrating residual target checks alongside behavioral changes across intervention strengths.
qsl2Sry3B2.problem: Performance drops after representation erasure conflate removal of target information with collateral disruption of other task-relevant features.
qsl2Sry3B2.method: CLEAR jointly evaluates behavioral changes with remaining linear target association, calibrated residual-test sensitivity, and responses across intervention strengths and replacement values. This calibration makes the resolution of each residual check explicit when interpreting causal edits.
qsl2Sry3B2.key_idea: Pairs behavioral effect measurements with calibrated residual-test sensitivity and sweeps over erasure strength and replacement values.
qsl2Sry3B2.evidence: Evaluated on synthetic zero-dependence controls and ego-state erasure across audited layers of the SSR autonomous-driving planner.
qsl2Sry3B2.claimed_gains: In the SSR planner, full ego state erasure raises 3 s average displacement error to 7.3 times its baseline value while failing residual checks at every audited layer.

0wu5ZePpMF.one_liner: Diversifies MoE adapter experts using fixed Hurwitz-Radon orthogonal-design view transforms around learnable cores.
0wu5ZePpMF.problem: Sparse MoE load-balancing heuristics promote statistical uniformity across experts without enforcing functional diversity, allowing expert collapse.
0wu5ZePpMF.method: STODA partitions the mapping space using Orthogonal Designs, giving each expert a view-core-unview structure composed of a fixed Hurwitz-Radon view transform, a learnable core module, and an inverse mapping. The anti-commutativity and skew-symmetry of the Hurwitz-Radon family yield orthogonal token views and non-degenerate routed mixtures.
0wu5ZePpMF.key_idea: Wraps each learnable adapter core in fixed Hurwitz-Radon view and inverse transforms to enforce algebraic orthogonality across routed experts.
0wu5ZePpMF.evidence: Supported by algebraic analysis of generator mixing and linearized-core collapse conditions, plus PEFT experiments on diffusion models.

Fy5k8CiOmb.one_liner: Learns a stateful stopping policy and diagnosis model to decide when and how to recover GUI agents.
Fy5k8CiOmb.problem: Triggering GUI-agent recovery immediately upon detecting an error can be suboptimal when later checkpoints offer higher recovery utility under a fixed step budget.
Fy5k8CiOmb.method: ReTIME pairs a stateful stopping policy that accumulates failure evidence, tracks progress, and reserves recovery budget with a learned diagnosis model that selects category-specific recovery guidance once intervention triggers. The authors also introduce ReTIME-Bench with 672 checkpoints from 133 failure trajectories.
Fy5k8CiOmb.key_idea: Uses a stateful stopping policy to time failure intervention under a budget and a learned diagnosis model to issue category-specific recovery guidance.
Fy5k8CiOmb.evidence: Supported by a counterfactual study of 120 failed OSWorld trajectories and evaluations of ReTIME-8B on ReTIME-Bench and OSWorld-Verified under a 50-step budget.
Fy5k8CiOmb.claimed_gains: In 120 failed OSWorld trajectories, 78.3% have a later checkpoint with higher recovery utility; ReTIME-8B reaches 56.31% timing balanced accuracy and 31.55% diagnosis accuracy on ReTIME-Bench, and 41.3% on OSWorld-Verified versus 36.3% for RoTS-7B.

HWEowEwKeT.one_liner: Freezes the pretrained model and SFT delta, learning entropy-minimizing token and module gates to suppress, reverse, or extrapolate features.
HWEowEwKeT.problem: Nonnegative token-reweighting methods in SFT can only attenuate or amplify updates and cannot reverse harmful learned features or cleanly extrapolate along a fixed SFT direction.
HWEowEwKeT.method: SCALE freezes both the pretrained weights and the SFT parameter delta, then learns bounded token- and module-specific gates by minimizing predictive entropy alone. These gates selectively suppress, reverse, or extrapolate frozen SFT features based on alignment with entropy reduction.
HWEowEwKeT.key_idea: Learns bounded token- and module-specific gates over a frozen SFT weight delta using predictive-entropy minimization to suppress, reverse, or extrapolate features.
HWEowEwKeT.evidence: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning benchmarks across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and Qwen3-4B-Base.
HWEowEwKeT.claimed_gains: SCALE achieves mathematical-reasoning averages of 37.84 on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, 43.60 on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and 36.57 on Qwen3-4B-Base.

N1Ut32ZwM7.one_liner: Tests feature-specific error correction in LLMs by fitting an Lp-norm model to residual-stream perturbation responses.
N1Ut32ZwM7.problem: Theoretical predictions that LLMs computing in superposition require error correction privileging feature directions over generic directions lacked empirical testing.
N1Ut32ZwM7.method: The authors perturb LLM residual-stream activations along candidate feature directions from contrastive prompt pairs and mixtures of directions, modeling response magnitude as a function of the Lp-norm of feature-component decompositions. Values of p > 2 break the quadratic-form rank limit of p = 2 and diagnose privileged feature directions.
N1Ut32ZwM7.key_idea: Perturbs residual-stream activations along pure and mixed candidate feature directions and fits an Lp-norm response where p > 2 indicates feature-specific error correction.
N1Ut32ZwM7.evidence: Empirical activation-perturbation tests across six LLMs comparing contrastive feature directions against non-feature baselines.
N1Ut32ZwM7.claimed_gains: Finds p > 2 across six LLMs for candidate feature directions compared with baselines at p ≈ 2.

meN6txbKOY.one_liner: Formalizes LLM agent harness costs via the Language Model Agent Machine, bounding communication, memory access, recomputation, and verification.
meN6txbKOY.problem: Standard model capability evaluations do not quantify the computational resources consumed by agent harnesses managing bounded context, external memory, tools, and verification.
meN6txbKOY.method: The authors define the Language Model Agent Machine (LAM), which fixes the semantic model while charging harness-level resources. Using red-blue pebbling reductions, pointer-chasing separations, bit-reversal DAGs, and checkpointing analysis, they derive lower bounds and optimal verification intervals.
meN6txbKOY.key_idea: Models fixed-LLM agent harnesses as a resource-bounded machine to derive pebbling I/O, memory-interface, recomputation, and checkpointing bounds.
meN6txbKOY.evidence: Supported by theoretical lower/upper bounds on pebbling, pointer chasing, bit-reversal DAGs, and reliability, plus GPT-6 Astra evaluations.
meN6txbKOY.claimed_gains: Proves a Θ(n) separation between random and non-speculative sequential memory access on pointer chasing and Θ(n^2/(C+S)+n) model calls on bit-reversal DAGs.

BuJGMgwdZb.one_liner: Refines prompt-specific preference DAGs from reward-model ensembles using a structural equation model and residual energy-based model.
BuJGMgwdZb.problem: Scalar pooling of reward-model ensembles hides inter-model disagreements, while naive graph aggregation retains conflicting preference edges.
BuJGMgwdZb.method: EDIT learns a prompt-specific preference graph from multiple reward models by pairing a structural equation model density with a residual energy-based model. The structural and energy modules are trained via SEM likelihood and noise contrastive estimation with adaptive negatives from a conditional flow, followed by acyclicity regularization and edge pruning.
BuJGMgwdZb.key_idea: Combines a structural equation model with a flow-sampled residual EBM, acyclicity regularization, and edge pruning to extract consistent preference DAGs from RM ensembles.
BuJGMgwdZb.evidence: Evaluated on RMB and AlpacaFarm for both response selection and policy optimization.

odjVzbTb0X.one_liner: Trains MLLMs to autoregressively predict quantized future-video visual tokens before event prediction, alongside VEPBench.
odjVzbTb0X.problem: Multimodal LLMs predicting future video events lack structured visual intermediate states without incurring pixel-reconstruction objectives.
odjVzbTb0X.method: Imagine in Discrete Space (IDS) quantizes future-video features into discrete visual tokens and trains an MLLM in three stages: autoregressive future-token prediction, grounding tokens in event descriptions, and reinforcement learning refinement. The authors also introduce VEPBench (about 3K samples) and a source-disjoint 17K-video training set.
odjVzbTb0X.key_idea: Quantizes future-video features into discrete tokens predicted autoregressively at inference to condition event prediction without pixel reconstruction.
odjVzbTb0X.evidence: Evaluated on VEPBench (~3K samples with a 17K-video training set) and cross-benchmark transfer to FutureBench.
odjVzbTb0X.claimed_gains: On VEPBench, IDS reaches 67.00% recorded-future selection before RL (versus 54.41% for the text-reasoning variant) and 72.78% for the full model.

TtzUhUFcz2.one_liner: Synthesizes real-time multi-agent, multi-view video world models using agent identity embeddings, dynamic geometry state, and causal distillation.
TtzUhUFcz2.problem: Existing action-conditioned video world models focus on single-agent settings and fail to capture multi-agent interactions with cross-view consistency.
TtzUhUFcz2.method: MultiWorld introduces Agent Identity Embedding for multi-agent controllability and a Dynamic Geometry World State to maintain coherence across parallel-synthesized views. It applies Causal Teacher Distillation to enable few-step interactive deployment across flexible agent and view counts.
TtzUhUFcz2.key_idea: Combines Agent Identity Embeddings, a Dynamic Geometry World State, and Causal Teacher Distillation for parallel multi-agent, multi-view video simulation.
TtzUhUFcz2.evidence: Evaluated on multi-player game environments and multi-robot manipulation tasks for video fidelity, action following, and multi-view consistency.
TtzUhUFcz2.claimed_gains: Few-step MultiWorld supports 24 FPS generation for both views.

2T6AiGjLQ0.one_liner: Diagnoses emergent misalignment via second-order training geometry and mitigates it by projecting harmful gradient subspaces out of updates.
2T6AiGjLQ0.problem: Narrow domain fine-tuning can trigger emergent misalignment across unrelated domains, while prior static analyses miss training dynamics and heuristic defenses hurt utility.
2T6AiGjLQ0.method: The authors track directional Hessian curvature and Grassmannian gradient projections during fine-tuning, finding curvature concentrates on semantic pivot tokens as safe-gradient overlap declines. They introduce a Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects the empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates.
2T6AiGjLQ0.key_idea: Orthogonally projects an empirical harmful gradient subspace out of fine-tuning parameter updates based on Hessian and Grassmannian trajectory diagnostics.
2T6AiGjLQ0.evidence: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-14B-IT and three additional open-weight instruction-tuned model families (3B–20B) using free-generation and teacher-forced evaluations.
2T6AiGjLQ0.claimed_gains: On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, the defense suppresses free-generation emergent misalignment by up to 80.0%.

vC301bKTCl.one_liner: Learns minimal linear recurrent realizations from finite Hankel blocks via decoupled concurrent gradient updates with global convergence.
vC301bKTCl.problem: Fitting finite Hankel blocks with unconstrained transitions does not guarantee accurate multistep predictions, and coupled gradient feedback creates attracting spurious local minima.
vC301bKTCl.method: The authors design a training procedure that updates state, decoder, and transition parameters concurrently while restricting each loss to its own parameter group, plus a computable certificate for safely switching to coupled updates. Pruning redundant dimensions from the converged state matrix yields a minimal-dimension exact predictor.
vC301bKTCl.key_idea: Updates state, decoder, and transition parameters concurrently with decoupled per-group losses and a switching certificate to avoid spurious attracting manifolds.
vC301bKTCl.evidence: Theoretical proofs of global convergence, spurious attracting manifolds under coupled feedback, deterministic fixed-step convergence, and fixed-length least-squares error bounds.

t5f1fTp3mu.one_liner: Maintains gated persistent object states over a sparse interaction graph to prevent identity drift in video segmentation.
t5f1fTp3mu.problem: Updating video instance histories unconditionally on every frame allows mismatches under occlusion or reappearance to overwrite valid histories and cause identity drift.
t5f1fTp3mu.method: POSReasoner maintains a compact per-object state storing identity, geometry, visibility history, and confidence, linked to candidate observations via a sparse interaction graph. Over multiple reasoning steps with intermediate supervision and a learned update gate, it decides whether to retain, update, or reactivate each object state.
t5f1fTp3mu.key_idea: Reasons over a sparse graph between candidate observations and persistent object states using a learned gate to retain, update, or reactivate identities.
t5f1fTp3mu.evidence: Trained with standard video annotations for long-term video object and instance segmentation.

13LdwlQOQD.one_liner: Trains a VLM to parse scenes into explicit scene-object-part-affordance hierarchies alongside a 110K-image benchmark.
13LdwlQOQD.problem: Existing visual grounding, part localization, and affordance methods make isolated predictions without modeling cross-level dependencies across a scene.
13LdwlQOQD.method: SceneParser trains a VLM for unified scene-to-object-to-part-to-affordance hierarchical generation using structural-completion pseudo labels and curriculum learning. The authors also build SceneParser-Bench via a hierarchical data engine and introduce Level-1 to Level-3 conditional metrics and ParseRate.
13LdwlQOQD.key_idea: Formulates visual understanding as unified VLM generation of bound scene-object-part-affordance hierarchies trained with structural-completion pseudo labels and curriculum learning.
13LdwlQOQD.evidence: Evaluated against existing MLLMs and hierarchy assembly pipelines on SceneParser-Bench (110K training images, 5K validation, 777K objects, 1.14M parts, 1.74M affordances).

MaEdZqi24s.one_liner: Establishes depth separation theorems for nonlinear state-space models on balanced-tree parity and deep quadratic sequence targets.
MaEdZqi24s.problem: The theoretical role of network depth versus recurrent memory and width in nonlinear state-space models for hierarchical sequence tasks is poorly understood.
MaEdZqi24s.method: The paper proves approximation lower bounds for constant-depth nonlinear SSMs on balanced-tree parity targets under norm and activation regularity constraints, and upper bounds for logarithmic-depth SSMs trained by normalized layerwise coordinate descent. It also constructs a depth-two nonlinear SSM that exactly represents a deep quadratic target unreachable by comparable constant-depth MLPs.
MaEdZqi24s.key_idea: Proves constant-depth SSM lower bounds and logarithmic-depth coordinate-descent upper bounds on balanced-tree parity, plus a depth-two SSM separation over constant-depth MLPs.
MaEdZqi24s.evidence: Theoretical approximation lower bounds, polynomial-sample learning upper bounds, and an explicit depth-two nonlinear SSM construction.

7XJFjwsC0g.one_liner: Co-evolves a reward-predicting video world model and a VLA policy in a closed RL loop using success/near-success data.
7XJFjwsC0g.problem: Real-world RL for VLA policies is costly and risky, while fixed action-conditioned video world models lack native reward signals, misalign on near-success failures, and drift as the policy updates.
7XJFjwsC0g.method: World-VLA-Loop curates the SANS dataset mixing successful and near-success trajectories, trains a state-aware video world model that jointly predicts future frames and binary rewards from diffusion latents, and closes the loop by using the world model for VLA RL post-training while feeding updated policy rollouts back to fine-tune the world model.
7XJFjwsC0g.key_idea: Jointly predicts video frames and binary rewards from diffusion latents trained on success/near-success data, iteratively co-evolving the world model and VLA policy.
7XJFjwsC0g.evidence: Evaluated in both simulation and real-robot experiments using the SANS dataset.

qKf79Fim0Z.one_liner: Uses teacher confidence to selectively intervene on student rollouts and adapt token-level distillation loss in VLMs.
qKf79Fim0Z.problem: On-policy distillation for autoregressive VLMs suffers when early unreliable student tokens derail rollouts, and prior interleaved methods use rigid ranking rules without adapting supervision to interventions.
qKf79Fim0Z.method: CA-OPD uses exact teacher confidence under a strict-to-relaxed schedule to selectively replace unreliable student tokens during rollouts. It aligns supervision with intervention decisions by applying direct cross-entropy loss on corrected positions and full-distribution teacher distillation on retained positions.
qKf79Fim0Z.key_idea: Triggers rollout token corrections via scheduled teacher-confidence thresholds and switches between hard cross-entropy on corrected tokens and full teacher-distribution distillation on retained tokens.
qKf79Fim0Z.evidence: Evaluated in a multi-teacher setting on GUI grounding and optical character recognition using a Qwen3.5-0.8B student baseline.

xbMYkksdsK.one_liner: Allocates mixed-precision LLM block bit-widths via candidate-specific Hessian-weighted quantization costs and a Lagrangian solver.
xbMYkksdsK.problem: Uniform sub-3-bit post-training quantization degrades LLM accuracy due to heterogeneous block sensitivity, while existing mixed-precision allocators ignore per-candidate error-reduction differences.
xbMYkksdsK.method: CostBit computes the Hessian-weighted quantization error cost for every candidate bit-width of each weight block and solves a Lagrangian allocation problem to match arbitrary (including non-integer) target average bit budgets.
xbMYkksdsK.key_idea: Evaluates candidate-specific Hessian-weighted block quantization errors and allocates mixed bit-widths via a Lagrangian solver matching non-integer target bit budgets.
xbMYkksdsK.evidence: Evaluated on OPT, LLaMA-2, and LLaMA-3 models (125M to 70B parameters) on WikiText-2 perplexity and zero-shot benchmarks against OWQ.
xbMYkksdsK.claimed_gains: At ~2.5 bits on LLaMA-2-7B, reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.69 to 6.43 and raises average zero-shot accuracy from 60.04% to 63.79% compared with OWQ.
